// Position-dependent convergence. The stock convergence_offset_* knobs above
// shift a channel uniformly across the whole screen, which no tube does. A real
// set is converged at the CENTRE by the service adjustment and drifts away from
// it, because the three beams take different-length paths through the
// deflection field. This returns the error for RED; blue gets the negation and
// green is the reference, which is the in-line gun order -- R, G, B in a row --
// that every consumer set has used since the early 70s.
//
// THIS EXTENDS THE STOCK KNOBS, it does not sit beside them. The static offsets
// are the order-0 (constant) term of the misconvergence field; what is below is
// the complete order-2 set. One code path: every getter returns base + bias.
//
// THE SHAPE OF THE ERROR IS NOT A FREE CHOICE. Red and blue sit at +d and -d
// either side of green, so the two of them are a MIRROR PAIR about the tube's
// vertical axis, and the yoke and the screen are mirror-symmetric about that
// axis as well. Reflecting the whole system therefore maps the red error onto
// the blue error. Writing D for the red-minus-blue separation, that forces
//
//     D.x EVEN in x        D.y ODD in x
//
// and the horizontal mirror, which does NOT swap the guns, forces
//
//     D.x EVEN in y        D.y ODD in y
//
// Antisymmetry -- blue being exactly the negation of red -- is IMPLIED by that
// parity rather than assumed alongside it: D.x even in x gives err_B.x =
// -err_R.x, and D.y odd in x gives err_B.y = -err_R.y.
//
// Ray-tracing agrees with the algebra. A beam offset +d in x that is heading
// RIGHT sits in the part of the yoke where the pincushion H field has
// dB/dx > 0, so it is over-deflected; the same beam heading LEFT sits where
// dB/dx < 0, so it is UNDER-deflected. Both cases land red displaced the same
// way, which is even in x. The odd alternative amounts to a magnification
// difference between the red and blue rasters, and a mirror-symmetric yoke
// cannot produce one at all: reflecting a set whose red raster is the larger
// gives a set whose BLUE raster is the larger, and that is the same set.
//
// So a RADIAL model -- error growing as r^2, pointing away from centre, red
// splaying outward -- has the wrong parity on both axes. That error is real,
// but it belongs to the yoke-TILT and neck-magnet class, i.e. to
// misADJUSTMENT, and not to the residual a correctly set up self-converging
// yoke leaves behind. What is modelled here is the residual. This was got
// wrong once already, on the first implementation, and corrected 2026-08-05
// after both edges were checked on screen.
//
// The three terms are every second-order term the two mirrors permit:
//
//   H_SIDES   dx += k * p.x^2 -- horizontal misconvergence growing toward the
//             LEFT AND RIGHT edges, the SAME sense at both. Service
//             nomenclature calls this XH, "the edge of X-axis horizontal
//             convergence error". The knob is the value at the edge, where
//             p.x^2 = 1, so no calibration factor is needed.
//
//   H_TOPBOT  dx += k * p.y^2 -- horizontal misconvergence at the TOP AND
//             BOTTOM of a CENTRE VERTICAL line, again the same sense at both.
//             This is YH, one of the residuals a self-converging yoke is
//             trimmed against with wedges. Knob is the edge value likewise.
//
//   V_CORNER  dy  = k * p.x * p.y -- vertical misconvergence, which the odd
//             parity pins to exactly ZERO along both centre lines and makes
//             largest in the CORNERS, flipping sign between adjacent ones.
//             This one is not a design failure but a geometric certainty: the
//             yoke literature notes that once the 3/9 and 6/12 o'clock errors
//             are wound out completely, a residual VERTICAL misconvergence
//             survives in the corner that is independent of the winding and
//             fixed by the geometry of the system. The knob is the corner
//             value, where p.x * p.y = 1.
//
// Note what is deliberately absent: NO vertical error anywhere on the
// horizontal centre line, and none on the vertical centre line either. A model
// that puts error there has the parity wrong.
//
// Both horizontal terms are even, so they ADD identically at all four corners
// and can never null one side of the picture against the other. There is no
// interaction to tune around.
//
// Also absent: COMA, i.e. green against red-and-blue together (HCR in the
// patent literature), which is a real and separately corrected mode. Green is
// on-axis, so the mirror maps it to itself and its own horizontal error is ODD
// in x -- the opposite parity to everything here. It would be its own pair of
// knobs on the green channel, and it is not modelled.
//
//   INNER     x^2 is smooth and monotonic; a real profile is not, because the
//             set was converged at the centre AND checked at the edge, so what
//             is left over peaks somewhere in between -- which is why service
//             literature measures inner and outer trap error as separate
//             figures. sin^2(pi*|p.x|) is zero at both ends and 1 at half
//             width, so this adds a mid-width lobe worth convergence_inner
//             edge-offsets and leaves the edge calibration exactly where it
//             was. The profile stops being monotonic above 0.47 and the lobe
//             exceeds the edge value above 0.71. It shapes H_SIDES only.
//             Because that term depends on p.x alone, the profile is exactly
//             what you see scanning along ANY horizontal line -- unlike a
//             radial profile, whose interesting part hides inboard of the edge
//             and cost a test to discover.
//
// The two axes are SEPARATE knobs because they are not comparably visible when
// the NTSC stage is in the chain. Composite NTSC has already smeared the
// horizontal axis to about 330 TVL while leaving the 480-line vertical grid
// sharp, so horizontal fringing has almost nothing to fringe against and needs
// a much larger value to read at all. That asymmetry is real -- it is why
// vertical misconvergence is the one you notice on a real composite set too --
// so it is exposed rather than papered over. Start at h_sides 2, h_topbot 1,
// v_corner 0.4.
vec2 royale_convergence_bias(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 p = (royale_uv - 0.5) * 2.;
    float prof = p.x * p.x;
    if (convergence_inner != 0.) {
        float s = sin(3.14159265 * p.x);
        prof += convergence_inner * s * s;
    }
    return vec2(convergence_h_sides * prof + convergence_h_topbot * p.y * p.y,
                convergence_v_corner * p.x * p.y);
}

vec3 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_x_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_x_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).x;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec3 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_y_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_y_r, global.convergence_offset_y_g, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).y;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec2 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_r_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_y_r);
    return base + royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

vec2 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_g_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_y_g);
    // Green is the reference gun, so it carries no bias -- the
    // argument is here to keep the three call sites uniform.
    return base;
}

vec2 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_b_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_b, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    return base - royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

vec2 vertex_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset() {
    return vertex_aa_subpixel_r_offset_static;
}

float vertex_get_mask_amplify() {
    float mask_grille_amplify = 1. / vertex_mask_grille_avg_color;
    float mask_slot_amplify = 1. / vertex_mask_slot_avg_color;
    float mask_shadow_amplify = 1. / vertex_mask_shadow_avg_color;
    return global.mask_type < 0.5 ? mask_grille_amplify : global.mask_type < 1.5 ? mask_slot_amplify : mask_shadow_amplify;
}

float vertex_get_mask_sample_mode() {
    return global.mask_sample_mode_desired;
}

float vertex_ntsc_gamma = 2.2;
float vertex_pal_gamma = 2.8;
float vertex_crt_reference_gamma_high = 2.5;
float vertex_crt_reference_gamma_low = 2.35;
float vertex_lcd_reference_gamma = 2.5;
float vertex_crt_office_gamma = 2.2;
float vertex_lcd_office_gamma = 2.2;
bool vertex_assume_opaque_alpha = false;
float vertex_get_crt_gamma() {
    return global.crt_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_gba_gamma() {
    return vertex_gba_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_lcd_gamma() {
    return global.lcd_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_intermediate_gamma() {
    return vertex_ntsc_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_input_gamma() {
    return vertex_get_crt_gamma();
}

float vertex_get_output_gamma() {
    return vertex_get_lcd_gamma();
}

bool vertex_linearize_input = false;
float vertex_get_pass_input_gamma() {
    return 1.;
}

bool vertex_gamma_encode_output = false;
float vertex_get_pass_output_gamma() {
    return 1.;
}

bool vertex_gamma_aware_bilinear = !vertex_linearize_input;
vec4 vertex_encode_output(vec4 color) {
    if (vertex_gamma_encode_output) {
        if (vertex_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / vertex_get_pass_output_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / vertex_get_pass_output_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 vertex_decode_input(vec4 color) {
    if (vertex_linearize_input) {
        if (vertex_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(vertex_get_pass_input_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(vertex_get_pass_input_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 vertex_decode_gamma_input(vec4 color, vec3 vertex_gamma) {
    if (vertex_assume_opaque_alpha) {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vertex_gamma), 1.);
    } else {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vertex_gamma), color.a);
    }
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords) {
    return vertex_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords) {
    return vertex_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords.xy));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords, texel_off));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, vec3 vertex_gamma) {
    return vertex_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.), vertex_gamma);
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off, vec3 vertex_gamma) {
    return vertex_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off), vertex_gamma);
}

vec4 vertex_erf6(vec4 x) {
    vec4 one = vec4(1.);
    vec4 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec4 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec4 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec3 vertex_erf6(vec3 x) {
    vec3 one = vec3(1.);
    vec3 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec3 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec3 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec2 vertex_erf6(vec2 x) {
    vec2 one = vec2(1.);
    vec2 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec2 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec2 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

float vertex_erf6(float x) {
    float sign_x = sign(x);
    float t = 1. / (1. + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    float result = 1. - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec4 vertex_erft(vec4 x) {
    return tanh(1.2027606 * x);
}

vec3 vertex_erft(vec3 x) {
    return tanh(1.2027606 * x);
}

vec2 vertex_erft(vec2 x) {
    return tanh(1.2027606 * x);
}

float vertex_erft(float x) {
    return tanh(1.2027606 * x);
}

vec4 vertex_erf(vec4 x) {
    return vertex_erf6(x);
}

vec3 vertex_erf(vec3 x) {
    return vertex_erf6(x);
}

vec2 vertex_erf(vec2 x) {
    return vertex_erf6(x);
}

float vertex_erf(float x) {
    return vertex_erf6(x);
}

vec4 vertex_gamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 g = vec4(1.1290683);
    vec4 c0 = vec4(0.81091195);
    vec4 c1 = vec4(0.48083547);
    vec4 e = vec4(2.7182817);
    vec4 sph = s + vec4(0.5);
    vec4 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec4(1.));
    vec4 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec3 vertex_gamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 g = vec3(1.1290683);
    vec3 c0 = vec3(0.81091195);
    vec3 c1 = vec3(0.48083547);
    vec3 e = vec3(2.7182817);
    vec3 sph = s + vec3(0.5);
    vec3 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec3(1.));
    vec3 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec2 vertex_gamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 g = vec2(1.1290683);
    vec2 c0 = vec2(0.81091195);
    vec2 c1 = vec2(0.48083547);
    vec2 e = vec2(2.7182817);
    vec2 sph = s + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec2(1.));
    vec2 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

float vertex_gamma_impl(float s, float s_inv) {
    float g = 1.1290683;
    float c0 = 0.81091195;
    float c1 = 0.48083547;
    float e = 2.7182817;
    float sph = s + 0.5;
    float lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + 1.);
    float base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec4 vertex_gamma(vec4 s) {
    return vertex_gamma_impl(s, vec4(1.) / s);
}

vec3 vertex_gamma(vec3 s) {
    return vertex_gamma_impl(s, vec3(1.) / s);
}

vec2 vertex_gamma(vec2 s) {
    return vertex_gamma_impl(s, vec2(1.) / s);
}

float vertex_gamma(float s) {
    return vertex_gamma_impl(s, 1. / s);
}

vec4 vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec4 sum = s_inv;
    vec4 z_sq = z * z;
    vec4 denom1 = s + vec4(1.);
    vec4 denom2 = 2. * s + vec4(4.);
    vec4 denom3 = 6. * s + vec4(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec3 vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec3 sum = s_inv;
    vec3 z_sq = z * z;
    vec3 denom1 = s + vec3(1.);
    vec3 denom2 = 2. * s + vec3(4.);
    vec3 denom3 = 6. * s + vec3(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec2 vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec2 sum = s_inv;
    vec2 z_sq = z * z;
    vec2 denom1 = s + vec2(1.);
    vec2 denom2 = 2. * s + vec2(4.);
    vec2 denom3 = 6. * s + vec2(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

float vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv) {
    float scale = pow(z, s);
    float sum = s_inv;
    float z_sq = z * z;
    float denom1 = s + 1.;
    float denom2 = 2. * s + 4.;
    float denom3 = 6. * s + 18.;
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec4 vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec4 denom = vec4(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec4(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec4(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec4(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(1.) + z - s + (s - vec4(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec3 vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec3 denom = vec3(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec3(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec3(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec3(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(1.) + z - s + (s - vec3(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec2 vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec2 denom = vec2(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec2(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec2(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec2(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(1.) + z - s + (s - vec2(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

float vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(float s, float z) {
    float numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    float denom = 7. + z - s;
    denom = 5. + z - s + (3. * s - 9.) / denom;
    denom = 3. + z - s + (2. * s - 4.) / denom;
    denom = 1. + z - s + (s - 1.) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec4 vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv, vec4 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec4 thresh = vec4(0.775075);
    bvec4 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    z_is_large.w = z.w > thresh.w;
    vec4 large_z = vec4(1.) - vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec4 small_z = vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec4 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec4(z_is_large) + small_z * vec4(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec3 vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv, vec3 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec3 thresh = vec3(0.775075);
    bvec3 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    vec3 large_z = vec3(1.) - vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec3 small_z = vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec3 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec3(z_is_large) + small_z * vec3(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec2 vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv, vec2 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec2 thresh = vec2(0.775075);
    bvec2 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    vec2 large_z = vec2(1.) - vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec2 small_z = vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec2 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec2(z_is_large) + small_z * vec2(inverse_z_is_large);
}

float vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv, float gamma_s_inv) {
    float thresh = 0.775075;
    bool z_is_large = z > thresh;
    float large_z = 1. - vertex_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    float small_z = vertex_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    return large_z * float(z_is_large) + small_z * float(!z_is_large);
}

vec4 vertex_normalized_ligamma(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 s_inv = vec4(1.) / s;
    vec4 gamma_s_inv = vec4(1.) / vertex_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec3 vertex_normalized_ligamma(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 s_inv = vec3(1.) / s;
    vec3 gamma_s_inv = vec3(1.) / vertex_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec2 vertex_normalized_ligamma(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 s_inv = vec2(1.) / s;
    vec2 gamma_s_inv = vec2(1.) / vertex_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

float vertex_normalized_ligamma(float s, float z) {
    float s_inv = 1. / s;
    float gamma_s_inv = 1. / vertex_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec3 vertex_get_gaussian_sigma(vec3 color, float sigma_range) {
    if (vertex_beam_spot_shape_function < 0.5) {
        return vec3(global.beam_min_sigma) + sigma_range * pow(color, vec3(global.beam_spot_power));
    } else {
        vec3 color_minus_1 = color - vec3(1.);
        return vec3(global.beam_min_sigma) + sigma_range * sqrt(vec3(1.) - color_minus_1 * color_minus_1);
    }
}

vec3 vertex_get_generalized_gaussian_beta(vec3 color, float shape_range) {
    return global.beam_min_shape + shape_range * pow(color, vec3(global.beam_shape_power));
}

vec3 vertex_scanline_gaussian_integral_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range) {
    vec3 sigma = vertex_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 ph_offset = vec3(pixel_height * 0.5);
    vec3 denom_inv = 1. / (sigma * sqrt(2.));
    vec3 integral_high = vertex_erf((dist + ph_offset) * denom_inv);
    vec3 integral_low = vertex_erf((dist - ph_offset) * denom_inv);
    return color * 0.5 * (integral_high - integral_low) / pixel_height;
}

vec3 vertex_scanline_generalized_gaussian_integral_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range, float shape_range) {
    vec3 alpha = sqrt(2.) * vertex_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 beta = vertex_get_generalized_gaussian_beta(color, shape_range);
    vec3 alpha_inv = vec3(1.) / alpha;
    vec3 s = vec3(1.) / beta;
    vec3 ph_offset = vec3(pixel_height * 0.5);
    vec3 gamma_s_inv = vec3(1.) / vertex_gamma_impl(s, beta);
    vec3 dist1 = dist + ph_offset;
    vec3 dist0 = dist - ph_offset;
    vec3 integral_high = sign(dist1) * vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, pow(abs(dist1) * alpha_inv, beta), beta, gamma_s_inv);
    vec3 integral_low = sign(dist0) * vertex_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, pow(abs(dist0) * alpha_inv, beta), beta, gamma_s_inv);
    return color * 0.5 * (integral_high - integral_low) / pixel_height;
}

vec3 vertex_scanline_gaussian_sampled_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range) {
    vec3 sigma = vertex_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 sigma_inv = vec3(1.) / sigma;
    vec3 inner_denom_inv = 0.5 * sigma_inv * sigma_inv;
    vec3 outer_denom_inv = sigma_inv / sqrt(2. * vertex_pi);
    if (vertex_beam_antialias_level > 0.5) {
        vec3 sample_offset = vec3(pixel_height / 3.);
        vec3 dist2 = dist + sample_offset;
        vec3 dist3 = abs(dist - sample_offset);
        vec3 scale = color / 3. * outer_denom_inv;
        vec3 weight1 = exp(-(dist * dist) * inner_denom_inv);
        vec3 weight2 = exp(-(dist2 * dist2) * inner_denom_inv);
        vec3 weight3 = exp(-(dist3 * dist3) * inner_denom_inv);
        return scale * (weight1 + weight2 + weight3);
    } else {
        return color * exp(-(dist * dist) * inner_denom_inv) * outer_denom_inv;
    }
}

vec3 vertex_scanline_generalized_gaussian_sampled_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range, float shape_range) {
    vec3 alpha = sqrt(2.) * vertex_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 beta = vertex_get_generalized_gaussian_beta(color, shape_range);
    vec3 alpha_inv = vec3(1.) / alpha;
    vec3 beta_inv = vec3(1.) / beta;
    vec3 scale = color * beta * 0.5 * alpha_inv / vertex_gamma_impl(beta_inv, beta);
    if (vertex_beam_antialias_level > 0.5) {
        vec3 sample_offset = vec3(pixel_height / 3.);
        vec3 dist2 = dist + sample_offset;
        vec3 dist3 = abs(dist - sample_offset);
        vec3 weight1 = exp(-pow(abs(dist * alpha_inv), beta));
        vec3 weight2 = exp(-pow(abs(dist2 * alpha_inv), beta));
        vec3 weight3 = exp(-pow(abs(dist3 * alpha_inv), beta));
        return scale / 3. * (weight1 + weight2 + weight3);
    } else {
        return scale * exp(-pow(abs(dist * alpha_inv), beta));
    }
}

vec3 vertex_scanline_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range, float shape_range) {
    if (vertex_beam_generalized_gaussian) {
        if (vertex_beam_antialias_level > 1.5) {
            return vertex_scanline_generalized_gaussian_integral_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range, shape_range);
        } else {
            return vertex_scanline_generalized_gaussian_sampled_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range, shape_range);
        }
    } else {
        if (vertex_beam_antialias_level > 1.5) {
            return vertex_scanline_gaussian_integral_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range);
        } else {
            return vertex_scanline_gaussian_sampled_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range);
        }
    }
}

vec3 vertex_get_raw_interpolated_color(vec3 color0, vec3 color1, vec3 color2, vec3 color3, vec4 weights) {
    return max(mat4x3(color0, color1, color2, color3) * weights, 0.);
}

vec3 vertex_get_interpolated_linear_color(vec3 color0, vec3 color1, vec3 color2, vec3 color3, vec4 weights) {
    float intermediate_gamma = vertex_get_intermediate_gamma();
    vec3 linear_mixed_color = vertex_get_raw_interpolated_color(color0, color1, color2, color3, weights);
    vec3 gamma_mixed_color = vertex_get_raw_interpolated_color(pow(color0, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), pow(color1, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), pow(color2, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), pow(color3, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), weights);
    return mix(gamma_mixed_color, linear_mixed_color, global.beam_horiz_linear_rgb_weight);
}

vec3 vertex_get_scanline_color(sampler2D tex, vec2 scanline_uv, vec2 uv_step_x, vec4 weights) {
    vec3 color1 = texture(tex, scanline_uv).rgb;
    vec3 color2 = texture(tex, scanline_uv + uv_step_x).rgb;
    vec3 color0 = vec3(0.);
    vec3 color3 = vec3(0.);
    if (global.beam_horiz_filter > 0.5) {
        color0 = texture(tex, scanline_uv - uv_step_x).rgb;
        color3 = texture(tex, scanline_uv + 2. * uv_step_x).rgb;
    }
    return vertex_get_interpolated_linear_color(color0, color1, color2, color3, weights);
}

vec3 vertex_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 tex_size, vec2 texture_size_inv) {
    vec2 curr_texel = tex_uv * tex_size;
    vec2 prev_texel = floor(curr_texel - vec2(vertex_under_half)) + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 prev_texel_hor = vec2(prev_texel.x, curr_texel.y);
    vec2 prev_texel_hor_uv = prev_texel_hor * texture_size_inv;
    float prev_dist = curr_texel.x - prev_texel_hor.x;
    vec4 sample_dists = vec4(1. + prev_dist, prev_dist, 1. - prev_dist, 2. - prev_dist);
    vec4 weights;
    if (global.beam_horiz_filter < 0.5) {
        float x = sample_dists.y;
        float w2 = x * x * x * (x * (x * 6. - 15.) + 10.);
        weights = vec4(0., 1. - w2, w2, 0.);
    } else if (global.beam_horiz_filter < 1.5) {
        float inner_denom_inv = 1. / (2. * global.beam_horiz_sigma * global.beam_horiz_sigma);
        weights = exp(-(sample_dists * sample_dists) * inner_denom_inv);
    } else {
        vec4 pi_dists = max(abs(sample_dists * vertex_pi), 0.000015258789);
        weights = 2. * sin(pi_dists) * sin(pi_dists * 0.5) / (pi_dists * pi_dists);
    }
    vec4 final_weights = weights / dot(weights, vec4(1.));
    vec2 uv_step_x = vec2(texture_size_inv.x, 0.);
    return vertex_get_scanline_color(tex, prev_texel_hor_uv, uv_step_x, final_weights);
}

vec3 vertex_sample_rgb_scanline_horizontal(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 tex_size, vec2 texture_size_inv) {
    if (vertex_beam_misconvergence) {
        vec3 convergence_offsets_rgb = vertex_get_convergence_offsets_x_vector(tex_uv);
        vec3 offset_u_rgb = convergence_offsets_rgb * texture_size_inv.xxx;
        vec2 scanline_uv_r = tex_uv - vec2(offset_u_rgb.r, 0.);
        vec2 scanline_uv_g = tex_uv - vec2(offset_u_rgb.g, 0.);
        vec2 scanline_uv_b = tex_uv - vec2(offset_u_rgb.b, 0.);
        vec3 sample_r = vertex_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, scanline_uv_r, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
        vec3 sample_g = vertex_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, scanline_uv_g, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
        vec3 sample_b = vertex_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, scanline_uv_b, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
        return vec3(sample_r.r, sample_g.g, sample_b.b);
    } else {
        return vertex_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, tex_uv, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
    }
}

vec2 vertex_get_last_scanline_uv(vec2 tex_uv, vec2 tex_size, vec2 texture_size_inv, vec2 il_step_multiple, float FrameCount, out float dist) {
    // PATCHED: FrameCount is a float here, so a plain `/ n` would be float
    // division and mod(n / 2, 2.) would walk 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 - half-scanline
    // field offsets. floor() keeps the two-state field parity this expects.
    float field_offset = floor(il_step_multiple.y * 0.75) * mod(royale_true_frame(FrameCount) + float(global.interlace_bff), 2.);
    vec2 curr_texel = tex_uv * tex_size;
    vec2 prev_texel_num = floor(curr_texel - vec2(vertex_under_half));
    float wrong_field = mod(prev_texel_num.y + field_offset, il_step_multiple.y);
    vec2 scanline_texel_num = prev_texel_num - vec2(0., wrong_field);
    vec2 scanline_texel = scanline_texel_num + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 scanline_uv = scanline_texel * texture_size_inv;
    dist = (curr_texel.y - scanline_texel.y) / il_step_multiple.y;
    return scanline_uv;
}

bool vertex_is_interlaced(float num_lines) {
    if (vertex_interlace_detect) {
        // SUPER: upstream only recognises the two interlaced formats that
        // actually exist in broadcast -- 289..576 lines (480i/576i carried as
        // fields) and exactly 1080 (1080i). 720 falls in neither window on
        // purpose: 720i is not a real format. That is correct for real content
        // and wrong for a synthetic analog grid, so analog_height=720 renders
        // progressive. royale_interlace_force = 1 overrides the test entirely
        // and interlaces at any line count.
        if (royale_interlace_force > 0.5) return true;
        bool sd_interlace = num_lines > 288.5 && num_lines < 576.5;
        bool hd_interlace = bool(global.interlace_1080i) ? num_lines > 1079.5 && num_lines < 1080.5 : false;
        return sd_interlace || hd_interlace;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

vec4 Position = vec4(HOOKED_pos, 0., 1.);
vec2 TexCoord = HOOKED_pos;
vec2 tex_uv;
vec2 blur_dxdy;
vec2 uv_scanline_step;
float estimated_viewport_size_x;
vec2 texture_size_inv;
vec2 tex_uv_to_pixel_scale;
// PATCHED (fix 7): upstream aliases the size of the texture this pass actually
// samples to params.SourceSize, which is the PREVIOUS pass -- VERTICAL_SCANLINES,
// (orig.w, viewport.h). Every use below that means "the size of the texture I am
// sampling" now reads bloom_approx_src_size instead. See the header.
vec2 bloom_approx_src_size = mix(params.SourceSize.xy, params.ORIG_LINEARIZEDSize.xy, bloom_approx_true_size);
void vertex_main() {
    vertex_gl_Position = global.MVP * Position;
    vec2 vTexCoord = TexCoord;
    vec2 video_uv = vTexCoord * params.SourceSize.xy / params.SourceSize.xy;
    tex_uv = video_uv * params.SourceSize.xy / params.SourceSize.xy;
    estimated_viewport_size_x = bloom_approx_src_size.y * global.geom_aspect_ratio_x / global.geom_aspect_ratio_y;
    vec2 dxdy_min_scale = bloom_approx_src_size / params.OutputSize.xy;
    texture_size_inv = vec2(1.) / bloom_approx_src_size;
    if (vertex_bloom_approx_filter > 1.5) {
        vec2 dxdy_scale = max(dxdy_min_scale, vec2(1.));
        blur_dxdy = dxdy_scale * texture_size_inv;
    } else {
        vec2 dxdy_scale = dxdy_min_scale;
        blur_dxdy = dxdy_scale * texture_size_inv;
    }
    tex_uv_to_pixel_scale = params.OutputSize.xy * params.SourceSize.xy / params.SourceSize.xy;
    vec2 orig_video_size = bloom_approx_src_size;
    float y_step = 1. + float(vertex_is_interlaced(orig_video_size.y));
    vec2 il_step_multiple = vec2(1., y_step);
    uv_scanline_step = il_step_multiple / bloom_approx_src_size;
}

vec3 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_x_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_x_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).x;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec3 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_y_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_y_r, global.convergence_offset_y_g, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).y;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec2 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_r_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_y_r);
    return base + royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

vec2 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_g_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_y_g);
    // Green is the reference gun, so it carries no bias -- the
    // argument is here to keep the three call sites uniform.
    return base;
}

vec2 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_b_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_b, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    return base - royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

    return global.mask_type < 0.5 ? mask_grille_amplify : global.mask_type < 1.5 ? mask_slot_amplify : mask_shadow_amplify;
}

    return 1.;

bool fragment_gamma_aware_bilinear = !fragment_linearize_input;
vec4 fragment_encode_output(vec4 color) {
    if (fragment_gamma_encode_output) {
        if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / fragment_get_pass_output_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / fragment_get_pass_output_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 fragment_decode_input(vec4 color) {
    if (fragment_linearize_input) {
        if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(fragment_get_pass_input_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(fragment_get_pass_input_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 fragment_decode_gamma_input(vec4 color, vec3 fragment_gamma) {
    if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, fragment_gamma), 1.);
    } else {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, fragment_gamma), color.a);
    }
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords) {

vec4 fragment_erf6(vec4 x) {
    vec4 one = vec4(1.);
    vec4 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec4 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec4 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec3 fragment_erf6(vec3 x) {
    vec3 one = vec3(1.);
    vec3 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec3 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec3 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec2 fragment_erf6(vec2 x) {
    vec2 one = vec2(1.);
    vec2 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec2 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec2 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

float fragment_erf6(float x) {
    float sign_x = sign(x);
    float t = 1. / (1. + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    float result = 1. - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec4 fragment_gamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 g = vec4(1.1290683);
    vec4 c0 = vec4(0.81091195);
    vec4 c1 = vec4(0.48083547);
    vec4 e = vec4(2.7182817);
    vec4 sph = s + vec4(0.5);
    vec4 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec4(1.));
    vec4 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_gamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 g = vec3(1.1290683);
    vec3 c0 = vec3(0.81091195);
    vec3 c1 = vec3(0.48083547);
    vec3 e = vec3(2.7182817);
    vec3 sph = s + vec3(0.5);
    vec3 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec3(1.));
    vec3 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec2 fragment_gamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 g = vec2(1.1290683);
    vec2 c0 = vec2(0.81091195);
    vec2 c1 = vec2(0.48083547);
    vec2 e = vec2(2.7182817);
    vec2 sph = s + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec2(1.));
    vec2 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

float fragment_gamma_impl(float s, float s_inv) {
    float g = 1.1290683;
    float c0 = 0.81091195;
    float c1 = 0.48083547;
    float e = 2.7182817;
    float sph = s + 0.5;
    float lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + 1.);
    float base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec4 fragment_gamma(vec4 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec4(1.) / s);
}

vec3 fragment_gamma(vec3 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec3(1.) / s);
}

vec2 fragment_gamma(vec2 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec2(1.) / s);
}

float fragment_gamma(float s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, 1. / s);
}

vec4 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec4 sum = s_inv;
    vec4 z_sq = z * z;
    vec4 denom1 = s + vec4(1.);
    vec4 denom2 = 2. * s + vec4(4.);
    vec4 denom3 = 6. * s + vec4(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec3 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec3 sum = s_inv;
    vec3 z_sq = z * z;
    vec3 denom1 = s + vec3(1.);
    vec3 denom2 = 2. * s + vec3(4.);
    vec3 denom3 = 6. * s + vec3(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec2 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec2 sum = s_inv;
    vec2 z_sq = z * z;
    vec2 denom1 = s + vec2(1.);
    vec2 denom2 = 2. * s + vec2(4.);
    vec2 denom3 = 6. * s + vec2(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

float fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv) {
    float scale = pow(z, s);
    float sum = s_inv;
    float z_sq = z * z;
    float denom1 = s + 1.;
    float denom2 = 2. * s + 4.;
    float denom3 = 6. * s + 18.;
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec4 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec4 denom = vec4(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec4(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec4(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec4(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(1.) + z - s + (s - vec4(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec3 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec3 denom = vec3(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec3(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec3(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec3(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(1.) + z - s + (s - vec3(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec2 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec2 denom = vec2(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec2(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec2(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec2(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(1.) + z - s + (s - vec2(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

float fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(float s, float z) {
    float numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    float denom = 7. + z - s;
    denom = 5. + z - s + (3. * s - 9.) / denom;
    denom = 3. + z - s + (2. * s - 4.) / denom;
    denom = 1. + z - s + (s - 1.) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec4 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv, vec4 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec4 thresh = vec4(0.775075);
    bvec4 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    z_is_large.w = z.w > thresh.w;
    vec4 large_z = vec4(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec4 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec4 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec4(z_is_large) + small_z * vec4(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec3 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv, vec3 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec3 thresh = vec3(0.775075);
    bvec3 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    vec3 large_z = vec3(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec3 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec3 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec3(z_is_large) + small_z * vec3(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec2 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv, vec2 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec2 thresh = vec2(0.775075);
    bvec2 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    vec2 large_z = vec2(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec2 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec2 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec2(z_is_large) + small_z * vec2(inverse_z_is_large);
}

float fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv, float gamma_s_inv) {
    float thresh = 0.775075;
    bool z_is_large = z > thresh;
    float large_z = 1. - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    float small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    return large_z * float(z_is_large) + small_z * float(!z_is_large);
}

vec4 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 s_inv = vec4(1.) / s;
    vec4 gamma_s_inv = vec4(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec3 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 s_inv = vec3(1.) / s;
    vec3 gamma_s_inv = vec3(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec2 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 s_inv = vec2(1.) / s;
    vec2 gamma_s_inv = vec2(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

float fragment_normalized_ligamma(float s, float z) {
    float s_inv = 1. / s;
    float gamma_s_inv = 1. / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec3 fragment_get_gaussian_sigma(vec3 color, float sigma_range) {
    if (fragment_beam_spot_shape_function < 0.5) {
        return vec3(global.beam_min_sigma) + sigma_range * pow(color, vec3(global.beam_spot_power));
    } else {
        vec3 color_minus_1 = color - vec3(1.);
        return vec3(global.beam_min_sigma) + sigma_range * sqrt(vec3(1.) - color_minus_1 * color_minus_1);
    }
}

vec3 fragment_get_generalized_gaussian_beta(vec3 color, float shape_range) {
    return global.beam_min_shape + shape_range * pow(color, vec3(global.beam_shape_power));
}

vec3 fragment_scanline_gaussian_integral_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range) {
    vec3 sigma = fragment_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 ph_offset = vec3(pixel_height * 0.5);
    vec3 denom_inv = 1. / (sigma * sqrt(2.));
    vec3 integral_high = fragment_erf((dist + ph_offset) * denom_inv);
    vec3 integral_low = fragment_erf((dist - ph_offset) * denom_inv);
    return color * 0.5 * (integral_high - integral_low) / pixel_height;
}

vec3 fragment_scanline_generalized_gaussian_integral_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range, float shape_range) {
    vec3 alpha = sqrt(2.) * fragment_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 beta = fragment_get_generalized_gaussian_beta(color, shape_range);
    vec3 alpha_inv = vec3(1.) / alpha;
    vec3 s = vec3(1.) / beta;
    vec3 ph_offset = vec3(pixel_height * 0.5);
    vec3 gamma_s_inv = vec3(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, beta);
    vec3 dist1 = dist + ph_offset;
    vec3 dist0 = dist - ph_offset;
    vec3 integral_high = sign(dist1) * fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, pow(abs(dist1) * alpha_inv, beta), beta, gamma_s_inv);
    vec3 integral_low = sign(dist0) * fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, pow(abs(dist0) * alpha_inv, beta), beta, gamma_s_inv);
    return color * 0.5 * (integral_high - integral_low) / pixel_height;
}

vec3 fragment_scanline_gaussian_sampled_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range) {
    vec3 sigma = fragment_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 sigma_inv = vec3(1.) / sigma;
    vec3 inner_denom_inv = 0.5 * sigma_inv * sigma_inv;
    vec3 outer_denom_inv = sigma_inv / sqrt(2. * fragment_pi);
    if (fragment_beam_antialias_level > 0.5) {
        vec3 sample_offset = vec3(pixel_height / 3.);
        vec3 dist2 = dist + sample_offset;
        vec3 dist3 = abs(dist - sample_offset);
        vec3 scale = color / 3. * outer_denom_inv;
        vec3 weight1 = exp(-(dist * dist) * inner_denom_inv);
        vec3 weight2 = exp(-(dist2 * dist2) * inner_denom_inv);
        vec3 weight3 = exp(-(dist3 * dist3) * inner_denom_inv);
        return scale * (weight1 + weight2 + weight3);
    } else {
        return color * exp(-(dist * dist) * inner_denom_inv) * outer_denom_inv;
    }
}

vec3 fragment_scanline_generalized_gaussian_sampled_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range, float shape_range) {
    vec3 alpha = sqrt(2.) * fragment_get_gaussian_sigma(color, sigma_range);
    vec3 beta = fragment_get_generalized_gaussian_beta(color, shape_range);
    vec3 alpha_inv = vec3(1.) / alpha;
    vec3 beta_inv = vec3(1.) / beta;
    vec3 scale = color * beta * 0.5 * alpha_inv / fragment_gamma_impl(beta_inv, beta);
    if (fragment_beam_antialias_level > 0.5) {
        vec3 sample_offset = vec3(pixel_height / 3.);
        vec3 dist2 = dist + sample_offset;
        vec3 dist3 = abs(dist - sample_offset);
        vec3 weight1 = exp(-pow(abs(dist * alpha_inv), beta));
        vec3 weight2 = exp(-pow(abs(dist2 * alpha_inv), beta));
        vec3 weight3 = exp(-pow(abs(dist3 * alpha_inv), beta));
        return scale / 3. * (weight1 + weight2 + weight3);
    } else {
        return scale * exp(-pow(abs(dist * alpha_inv), beta));
    }
}

vec3 fragment_scanline_contrib(vec3 dist, vec3 color, float pixel_height, float sigma_range, float shape_range) {
    if (fragment_beam_generalized_gaussian) {
        if (fragment_beam_antialias_level > 1.5) {
            return fragment_scanline_generalized_gaussian_integral_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range, shape_range);
        } else {
            return fragment_scanline_generalized_gaussian_sampled_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range, shape_range);
        }
    } else {
        if (fragment_beam_antialias_level > 1.5) {
            return fragment_scanline_gaussian_integral_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range);
        } else {
            return fragment_scanline_gaussian_sampled_contrib(dist, color, pixel_height, sigma_range);
        }
    }
}

vec3 fragment_get_raw_interpolated_color(vec3 color0, vec3 color1, vec3 color2, vec3 color3, vec4 weights) {
    return max(mat4x3(color0, color1, color2, color3) * weights, 0.);
}

vec3 fragment_get_interpolated_linear_color(vec3 color0, vec3 color1, vec3 color2, vec3 color3, vec4 weights) {
    float intermediate_gamma = fragment_get_intermediate_gamma();
    vec3 linear_mixed_color = fragment_get_raw_interpolated_color(color0, color1, color2, color3, weights);
    vec3 gamma_mixed_color = fragment_get_raw_interpolated_color(pow(color0, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), pow(color1, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), pow(color2, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), pow(color3, vec3(1. / intermediate_gamma)), weights);
    return mix(gamma_mixed_color, linear_mixed_color, global.beam_horiz_linear_rgb_weight);
}

vec3 fragment_get_scanline_color(sampler2D tex, vec2 scanline_uv, vec2 uv_step_x, vec4 weights) {
    vec3 color1 = texture(tex, scanline_uv).rgb;
    vec3 color2 = texture(tex, scanline_uv + uv_step_x).rgb;
    vec3 color0 = vec3(0.);
    vec3 color3 = vec3(0.);
    if (global.beam_horiz_filter > 0.5) {
        color0 = texture(tex, scanline_uv - uv_step_x).rgb;
        color3 = texture(tex, scanline_uv + 2. * uv_step_x).rgb;
    }
    return fragment_get_interpolated_linear_color(color0, color1, color2, color3, weights);
}

vec3 fragment_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 tex_size, vec2 texture_size_inv) {
    vec2 curr_texel = tex_uv * tex_size;
    vec2 prev_texel = floor(curr_texel - vec2(fragment_under_half)) + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 prev_texel_hor = vec2(prev_texel.x, curr_texel.y);
    vec2 prev_texel_hor_uv = prev_texel_hor * texture_size_inv;
    float prev_dist = curr_texel.x - prev_texel_hor.x;
    vec4 sample_dists = vec4(1. + prev_dist, prev_dist, 1. - prev_dist, 2. - prev_dist);
    vec4 weights;
    if (global.beam_horiz_filter < 0.5) {
        float x = sample_dists.y;
        float w2 = x * x * x * (x * (x * 6. - 15.) + 10.);
        weights = vec4(0., 1. - w2, w2, 0.);
    } else if (global.beam_horiz_filter < 1.5) {
        float inner_denom_inv = 1. / (2. * global.beam_horiz_sigma * global.beam_horiz_sigma);
        weights = exp(-(sample_dists * sample_dists) * inner_denom_inv);
    } else {
        vec4 pi_dists = max(abs(sample_dists * fragment_pi), 0.000015258789);
        weights = 2. * sin(pi_dists) * sin(pi_dists * 0.5) / (pi_dists * pi_dists);
    }
    vec4 final_weights = weights / dot(weights, vec4(1.));
    vec2 uv_step_x = vec2(texture_size_inv.x, 0.);
    return fragment_get_scanline_color(tex, prev_texel_hor_uv, uv_step_x, final_weights);
}

vec3 fragment_sample_rgb_scanline_horizontal(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 tex_size, vec2 texture_size_inv) {
    if (fragment_beam_misconvergence) {
        vec3 convergence_offsets_rgb = fragment_get_convergence_offsets_x_vector(tex_uv);
        vec3 offset_u_rgb = convergence_offsets_rgb * texture_size_inv.xxx;
        vec2 scanline_uv_r = tex_uv - vec2(offset_u_rgb.r, 0.);
        vec2 scanline_uv_g = tex_uv - vec2(offset_u_rgb.g, 0.);
        vec2 scanline_uv_b = tex_uv - vec2(offset_u_rgb.b, 0.);
        vec3 sample_r = fragment_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, scanline_uv_r, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
        vec3 sample_g = fragment_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, scanline_uv_g, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
        vec3 sample_b = fragment_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, scanline_uv_b, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
        return vec3(sample_r.r, sample_g.g, sample_b.b);
    } else {
        return fragment_sample_single_scanline_horizontal(tex, tex_uv, tex_size, texture_size_inv);
    }
}

vec2 fragment_get_last_scanline_uv(vec2 tex_uv, vec2 tex_size, vec2 texture_size_inv, vec2 il_step_multiple, float FrameCount, out float dist) {
    // PATCHED: FrameCount is a float here, so a plain `/ n` would be float
    // division and mod(n / 2, 2.) would walk 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 - half-scanline
    // field offsets. floor() keeps the two-state field parity this expects.
    float field_offset = floor(il_step_multiple.y * 0.75) * mod(royale_true_frame(FrameCount) + float(global.interlace_bff), 2.);
    vec2 curr_texel = tex_uv * tex_size;
    vec2 prev_texel_num = floor(curr_texel - vec2(fragment_under_half));
    float wrong_field = mod(prev_texel_num.y + field_offset, il_step_multiple.y);
    vec2 scanline_texel_num = prev_texel_num - vec2(0., wrong_field);
    vec2 scanline_texel = scanline_texel_num + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 scanline_uv = scanline_texel * texture_size_inv;
    dist = (curr_texel.y - scanline_texel.y) / il_step_multiple.y;
    return scanline_uv;
}

bool fragment_is_interlaced(float num_lines) {
    if (fragment_interlace_detect) {
        // SUPER: upstream only recognises the two interlaced formats that
        // actually exist in broadcast -- 289..576 lines (480i/576i carried as
        // fields) and exactly 1080 (1080i). 720 falls in neither window on
        // purpose: 720i is not a real format. That is correct for real content
        // and wrong for a synthetic analog grid, so analog_height=720 renders
        // progressive. royale_interlace_force = 1 overrides the test entirely
        // and interlaces at any line count.
        if (royale_interlace_force > 0.5) return true;
        bool sd_interlace = num_lines > 288.5 && num_lines < 576.5;
        bool hd_interlace = bool(global.interlace_1080i) ? num_lines > 1079.5 && num_lines < 1080.5 : false;
        return sd_interlace || hd_interlace;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

vec4 FragColor;
#define Source VERTICAL_SCANLINES_raw
// PATCHED (fix 6): the halation/diffusion chain is fed from DIFFUSION_SRC, which
// is ORIG_LINEARIZED without the bob. Everything else about this pass is unchanged.
#define ORIG_LINEARIZED DIFFUSION_SRC_raw
#define Original MAIN_RGB_raw
float fragment_blur3_std_dev = 0.62666017;
float fragment_blur4_std_dev = 0.6617187;
float fragment_blur5_std_dev = 0.9845703;
float fragment_blur6_std_dev = 1.0262696;
float fragment_blur7_std_dev = 1.3610351;
float fragment_blur8_std_dev = 1.4080079;
float fragment_blur9_std_dev = 1.7533203;

float fragment_blur11_std_dev = 2.1598632;
float fragment_blur12_std_dev = 2.2152343;
float fragment_blur17_std_dev = 3.455356;
float fragment_blur25_std_dev = 5.3409576;
float fragment_blur31_std_dev = 6.8648806;
float fragment_blur43_std_dev = 10.185205;

vec4 fragment_get_quad_vector_naive(vec4 output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy) {
    vec4 pixel_odd = fract(output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy * 0.5) * 2.;
    vec4 quad_vector = pixel_odd * 2. - vec4(1.);
    return quad_vector;
}

vec4 fragment_get_quad_vector(vec4 output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy) {
    vec4 quad_vector_guess = fragment_get_quad_vector_naive(output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy);
    vec2 odd_start_mirror = 0.5 * vec2(dFdx(quad_vector_guess.z), dFdy(quad_vector_guess.w));
    return quad_vector_guess * odd_start_mirror.xyxy;
}

vec4 fragment_get_quad_vector(vec2 output_pixel_num_wrt_uv) {
    vec2 screen_uv_mirror = vec2(dFdx(output_pixel_num_wrt_uv.x), dFdy(output_pixel_num_wrt_uv.y));
    vec2 pixel_odd_wrt_uv = fract(output_pixel_num_wrt_uv * 0.5) * 2.;
    vec2 quad_vector_uv_guess = (pixel_odd_wrt_uv - vec2(0.5)) * 2.;
    vec2 quad_vector_screen_guess = quad_vector_uv_guess * screen_uv_mirror;
    vec2 odd_start_mirror = 0.5 * vec2(dFdx(quad_vector_screen_guess.x), dFdy(quad_vector_screen_guess.y));
    vec4 quad_vector_guess = vec4(quad_vector_uv_guess, quad_vector_screen_guess);
    return quad_vector_guess * odd_start_mirror.xyxy;
}

void fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, vec4 curr, out vec4 adjx, out vec4 adjy, out vec4 diag) {
    adjx = curr - dFdx(curr) * quad_vector.z;
    adjy = curr - dFdy(curr) * quad_vector.w;
    diag = adjx - dFdy(adjx) * quad_vector.w;
}

void fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, vec3 curr, out vec3 adjx, out vec3 adjy, out vec3 diag) {
    adjx = curr - dFdx(curr) * quad_vector.z;
    adjy = curr - dFdy(curr) * quad_vector.w;
    diag = adjx - dFdy(adjx) * quad_vector.w;
}

void fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, vec2 curr, out vec2 adjx, out vec2 adjy, out vec2 diag) {
    adjx = curr - dFdx(curr) * quad_vector.z;
    adjy = curr - dFdy(curr) * quad_vector.w;
    diag = adjx - dFdy(adjx) * quad_vector.w;
}

vec4 fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, float curr) {
    vec4 all = vec4(curr);
    all.y = all.x - dFdx(all.x) * quad_vector.z;
    all.zw = all.xy - dFdy(all.xy) * quad_vector.w;
    return all;
}

vec4 fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, vec4 curr) {
    vec4 adjx, adjy, diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr, adjx, adjy, diag);
    return curr + adjx + adjy + diag;
}

vec3 fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, vec3 curr) {
    vec3 adjx, adjy, diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr, adjx, adjy, diag);
    return curr + adjx + adjy + diag;
}

vec2 fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, vec2 curr) {
    vec2 adjx, adjy, diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr, adjx, adjy, diag);
    return curr + adjx + adjy + diag;
}

float fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, float curr) {
    vec4 all_values = fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr);
    return all_values.x + all_values.y + all_values.z + all_values.w;
}

bool fragment_fine_derivatives_working(vec4 quad_vector, vec4 curr) {
    vec4 ddx_curr = dFdx(curr);
    vec4 ddy_curr = dFdy(curr);
    vec4 adjx = curr - ddx_curr * quad_vector.z;
    vec4 adjy = curr - ddy_curr * quad_vector.w;
    bool ddy_different = any(bvec4(ddy_curr.x != dFdy(adjx).x, ddy_curr.y != dFdy(adjx).y, ddy_curr.z != dFdy(adjx).z, ddy_curr.w != dFdy(adjx).w));
    bool ddx_different = any(bvec4(ddx_curr.x != dFdx(adjy).x, ddx_curr.y != dFdx(adjy).y, ddx_curr.z != dFdx(adjy).z, ddx_curr.w != dFdx(adjy).w));
    return any(bvec2(ddy_different, ddx_different));
}

bool fragment_fine_derivatives_working_fast(vec4 quad_vector, float curr) {
    float ddx_curr = dFdx(curr);
    float ddy_curr = dFdy(curr);
    float adjx = curr - ddx_curr * quad_vector.z;
    return ddy_curr != dFdy(adjx);
}

vec4 fragment_uv2_to_uv4(vec2 tex_uv) {
    return vec4(tex_uv, 0., 0.);
}

float fragment_get_fast_gaussian_weight_sum_inv(float sigma) {
    return min(exp(exp(0.3483484 / (sigma - 0.08605873))), 0.39933458 / sigma);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur11resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float w5 = exp(-25. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5));
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 5. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 5. * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur11fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float w5 = exp(-25. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5));
    float w01 = w0 * 0.5 + w1;
    float w23 = w2 + w3;
    float w45 = w4 + w5;
    float w01_ratio = w1 / w01;
    float w23_ratio = w3 / w23;
    float w45_ratio = w5 / w45;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w45 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (4. + w45_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w45 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (4. + w45_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}
