vec4 fragment_gamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 g = vec4(1.1290683);
    vec4 c0 = vec4(0.81091195);
    vec4 c1 = vec4(0.48083547);
    vec4 e = vec4(2.7182817);
    vec4 sph = s + vec4(0.5);
    vec4 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec4(1.));
    vec4 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_gamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 g = vec3(1.1290683);
    vec3 c0 = vec3(0.81091195);
    vec3 c1 = vec3(0.48083547);
    vec3 e = vec3(2.7182817);
    vec3 sph = s + vec3(0.5);
    vec3 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec3(1.));
    vec3 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec2 fragment_gamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 g = vec2(1.1290683);
    vec2 c0 = vec2(0.81091195);
    vec2 c1 = vec2(0.48083547);
    vec2 e = vec2(2.7182817);
    vec2 sph = s + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec2(1.));
    vec2 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

float fragment_gamma_impl(float s, float s_inv) {
    float g = 1.1290683;
    float c0 = 0.81091195;
    float c1 = 0.48083547;
    float e = 2.7182817;
    float sph = s + 0.5;
    float lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + 1.);
    float base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec4 fragment_gamma(vec4 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec4(1.) / s);
}

vec3 fragment_gamma(vec3 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec3(1.) / s);
}

vec2 fragment_gamma(vec2 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec2(1.) / s);
}

float fragment_gamma(float s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, 1. / s);
}

vec4 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec4 sum = s_inv;
    vec4 z_sq = z * z;
    vec4 denom1 = s + vec4(1.);
    vec4 denom2 = 2. * s + vec4(4.);
    vec4 denom3 = 6. * s + vec4(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec3 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec3 sum = s_inv;
    vec3 z_sq = z * z;
    vec3 denom1 = s + vec3(1.);
    vec3 denom2 = 2. * s + vec3(4.);
    vec3 denom3 = 6. * s + vec3(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec2 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec2 sum = s_inv;
    vec2 z_sq = z * z;
    vec2 denom1 = s + vec2(1.);
    vec2 denom2 = 2. * s + vec2(4.);
    vec2 denom3 = 6. * s + vec2(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

float fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv) {
    float scale = pow(z, s);
    float sum = s_inv;
    float z_sq = z * z;
    float denom1 = s + 1.;
    float denom2 = 2. * s + 4.;
    float denom3 = 6. * s + 18.;
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec4 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec4 denom = vec4(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec4(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec4(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec4(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(1.) + z - s + (s - vec4(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec3 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec3 denom = vec3(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec3(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec3(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec3(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(1.) + z - s + (s - vec3(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec2 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec2 denom = vec2(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec2(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec2(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec2(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(1.) + z - s + (s - vec2(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

float fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(float s, float z) {
    float numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    float denom = 7. + z - s;
    denom = 5. + z - s + (3. * s - 9.) / denom;
    denom = 3. + z - s + (2. * s - 4.) / denom;
    denom = 1. + z - s + (s - 1.) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec4 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv, vec4 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec4 thresh = vec4(0.775075);
    bvec4 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    z_is_large.w = z.w > thresh.w;
    vec4 large_z = vec4(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec4 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec4 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec4(z_is_large) + small_z * vec4(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec3 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv, vec3 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec3 thresh = vec3(0.775075);
    bvec3 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    vec3 large_z = vec3(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec3 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec3 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec3(z_is_large) + small_z * vec3(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec2 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv, vec2 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec2 thresh = vec2(0.775075);
    bvec2 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    vec2 large_z = vec2(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec2 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec2 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec2(z_is_large) + small_z * vec2(inverse_z_is_large);
}

float fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv, float gamma_s_inv) {
    float thresh = 0.775075;
    bool z_is_large = z > thresh;
    float large_z = 1. - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    float small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    return large_z * float(z_is_large) + small_z * float(!z_is_large);
}

vec4 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 s_inv = vec4(1.) / s;
    vec4 gamma_s_inv = vec4(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec3 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 s_inv = vec3(1.) / s;
    vec3 gamma_s_inv = vec3(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec2 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 s_inv = vec2(1.) / s;
    vec2 gamma_s_inv = vec2(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

float fragment_normalized_ligamma(float s, float z) {
    float s_inv = 1. / s;
    float gamma_s_inv = 1. / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec4 fragment_uv2_to_uv4(vec2 tex_uv) {
    return vec4(tex_uv, 0., 0.);
}

float fragment_get_fast_gaussian_weight_sum_inv(float sigma) {
    return min(exp(exp(0.3483484 / (sigma - 0.08605873))), 0.39933458 / sigma);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur11resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float w5 = exp(-25. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5));
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 5. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 5. * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur11fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float w5 = exp(-25. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5));
    float w01 = w0 * 0.5 + w1;
    float w23 = w2 + w3;
    float w45 = w4 + w5;
    float w01_ratio = w1 / w01;
    float w23_ratio = w3 / w23;
    float w45_ratio = w5 / w45;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w45 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (4. + w45_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w45 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (4. + w45_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

    float w1_2 = w1 + w2;
    float w3_4 = w3 + w4;
    float w5_6 = w5 + w6;
    float w7_8 = w7 + w8;
    float w1_2_ratio = w2 / w1_2;
    float w3_4_ratio = w4 / w3_4;
    float w5_6_ratio = w6 / w5_6;
    float w7_8_ratio = w8 / w7_8;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w7_8 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (7. + w7_8_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w5_6 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (5. + w5_6_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3_4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (3. + w3_4_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1_2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (1. + w1_2_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1_2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (1. + w1_2_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3_4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (3. + w3_4_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w5_6 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (5. + w5_6_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w7_8 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (7. + w7_8_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur3x3resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    vec2 sample4_uv = tex_uv;
    vec2 dx = vec2(dxdy.x, 0.);
    vec2 dy = vec2(0., dxdy.y);
    vec2 sample1_uv = sample4_uv - dy;
    vec2 sample7_uv = sample4_uv + dy;
    vec3 sample0 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample1_uv - dx).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample1_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample1_uv + dx).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample4_uv - dx).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample4_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample5 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample4_uv + dx).rgb;
    vec3 sample6 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample7_uv - dx).rgb;
    vec3 sample7 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample7_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample8 = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, sample7_uv + dx).rgb;
    float w4 = 1.;
    float w1_3_5_7 = exp(-dot(vec2(1., 0.), vec2(1., 0.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0_2_6_8 = exp(-dot(vec2(1., 1.), vec2(1., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w4 + 4. * (w1_3_5_7 + w0_2_6_8));
    vec3 sum = w4 * sample4 + w1_3_5_7 * (sample1 + sample3 + sample5 + sample7) + w0_2_6_8 * (sample0 + sample2 + sample6 + sample8);
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur9x9(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w1off = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2off = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3off = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4off = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float texel1to2ratio = w2off / (w1off + w2off);
    float texel3to4ratio = w4off / (w3off + w4off);
    vec2 sample1R_texel_offset = vec2(1., 0.) + vec2(texel1to2ratio, 0.);
    vec2 sample2R_texel_offset = vec2(3., 0.) + vec2(texel3to4ratio, 0.);
    vec2 sample3d_texel_offset = vec2(1., 1.) + vec2(texel1to2ratio, texel1to2ratio);
    vec2 sample4d_texel_offset = vec2(3., 1.) + vec2(texel3to4ratio, texel1to2ratio);
    vec2 sample5d_texel_offset = vec2(1., 3.) + vec2(texel1to2ratio, texel3to4ratio);
    vec2 sample6d_texel_offset = vec2(3., 3.) + vec2(texel3to4ratio, texel3to4ratio);
    float w1R1 = w1off;
    float w1R2 = w2off;
    float w2R1 = w3off;
    float w2R2 = w4off;
    float w3d1 = exp(-dot(vec2(1., 1.), vec2(1., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3d2_3d3 = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 1.), vec2(2., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3d4 = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2.), vec2(2., 2.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4d1_5d1 = exp(-dot(vec2(3., 1.), vec2(3., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4d2_5d3 = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 1.), vec2(4., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4d3_5d2 = exp(-dot(vec2(3., 2.), vec2(3., 2.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4d4_5d4 = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 2.), vec2(4., 2.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6d1 = exp(-dot(vec2(3., 3.), vec2(3., 3.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6d2_6d3 = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 3.), vec2(4., 3.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6d4 = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 4.), vec2(4., 4.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = w1R1 + w1R2;
    float w2 = w2R1 + w2R2;
    float w3 = w3d1 + 2. * w3d2_3d3 + w3d4;
    float w4 = w4d1_5d1 + w4d2_5d3 + w4d3_5d2 + w4d4_5d4;
    float w5 = w4;
    float w6 = w6d1 + 2. * w6d2_6d3 + w6d4;
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 4. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5 + w6));
    vec2 mirror_x = vec2(-1., 1.);
    vec2 mirror_y = vec2(1., -1.);
    vec2 mirror_xy = vec2(-1., -1.);
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_x = dxdy * mirror_x;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_y = dxdy * mirror_y;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_xy = dxdy * mirror_xy;
    vec3 sample0C = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample1R = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1D = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset.yx).rgb;
    vec3 sample1L = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1U = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset.yx).rgb;
    vec3 sample2R = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample2R_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2D = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample2R_texel_offset.yx).rgb;
    vec3 sample2L = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - dxdy * sample2R_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2U = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - dxdy * sample2R_texel_offset.yx).rgb;
    vec3 sample3d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample3c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample3b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample3a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample5d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample5d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample5c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample5d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample5b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample5d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample5a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample5d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample6d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample6d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample6c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample6d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample6b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample6d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample6a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample6d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sum = w0 * sample0C;
    sum += w1 * (sample1R + sample1D + sample1L + sample1U);
    sum += w2 * (sample2R + sample2D + sample2L + sample2U);
    sum += w3 * (sample3d + sample3c + sample3b + sample3a);
    sum += w4 * (sample4d + sample4c + sample4b + sample4a);
    sum += w5 * (sample5d + sample5c + sample5b + sample5a);
    sum += w6 * (sample6d + sample6c + sample6b + sample6a);
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur7x7(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0off = 1.;
    float w1off = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2off = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3off = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float texel0to1ratio = w1off / (w0off * 0.5 + w1off);
    float texel2to3ratio = w3off / (w2off + w3off);
    vec2 sample1d_texel_offset = vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample2d_texel_offset = vec2(2., 0.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample3d_texel_offset = vec2(0., 2.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample4d_texel_offset = vec2(2., 2.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    float w1abcd = 1.;
    float w1bd2_1cd3 = exp(-dot(vec2(1., 0.), vec2(1., 0.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2bd1_3cd1 = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0.), vec2(2., 0.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2bd2_3cd2 = exp(-dot(vec2(3., 0.), vec2(3., 0.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1d4 = exp(-dot(vec2(1., 1.), vec2(1., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2d3_3d2 = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 1.), vec2(2., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2d4_3d4 = exp(-dot(vec2(3., 1.), vec2(3., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4d1 = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2.), vec2(2., 2.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4d2_4d3 = exp(-dot(vec2(3., 2.), vec2(3., 2.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4d4 = exp(-dot(vec2(3., 3.), vec2(3., 3.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1 = w1abcd * 0.25 + w1bd2_1cd3 + w1d4;
    float w2_3 = (w2bd1_3cd1 + w2bd2_3cd2) * 0.5 + w2d3_3d2 + w2d4_3d4;
    float w4 = w4d1 + 2. * w4d2_4d3 + w4d4;
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (4. * (w1 + 2. * w2_3 + w4));
    vec2 mirror_x = vec2(-1., 1.);
    vec2 mirror_y = vec2(1., -1.);
    vec2 mirror_xy = vec2(-1., -1.);
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_x = dxdy * mirror_x;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_y = dxdy * mirror_y;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_xy = dxdy * mirror_xy;
    vec3 sample1a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample1d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample3a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample1d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample3b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample1d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample3c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample1d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample3d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample3d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample4d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample4d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w1 * (sample1a + sample1b + sample1c + sample1d);
    sum += w2_3 * (sample2a + sample2b + sample2c + sample2d);
    sum += w2_3 * (sample3a + sample3b + sample3c + sample3d);
    sum += w4 * (sample4a + sample4b + sample4c + sample4d);
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur5x5(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w1off = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2off = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float texel1to2ratio = w2off / (w1off + w2off);
    vec2 sample1R_texel_offset = vec2(1., 0.) + vec2(texel1to2ratio, 0.);
    vec2 sample2d_texel_offset = vec2(1., 1.) + vec2(texel1to2ratio, texel1to2ratio);
    float w1R1 = w1off;
    float w1R2 = w2off;
    float w2d1 = exp(-dot(vec2(1., 1.), vec2(1., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2d2_3 = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 1.), vec2(2., 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2d4 = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2.), vec2(2., 2.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = w1R1 + w1R2;
    float w2 = w2d1 + 2. * w2d2_3 + w2d4;
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 4. * (w1 + w2));
    vec2 mirror_x = vec2(-1., 1.);
    vec2 mirror_y = vec2(1., -1.);
    vec2 mirror_xy = vec2(-1., -1.);
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_x = dxdy * mirror_x;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_y = dxdy * mirror_y;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_xy = dxdy * mirror_xy;
    vec3 sample0C = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample1R = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1D = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset.yx).rgb;
    vec3 sample1L = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1U = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - dxdy * sample1R_texel_offset.yx).rgb;
    vec3 sample2d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample2a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample2d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sum = w0 * sample0C;
    sum += w1 * (sample1R + sample1D + sample1L + sample1U);
    sum += w2 * (sample2a + sample2b + sample2c + sample2d);
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur3x3(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0off = 1.;
    float w1off = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float texel0to1ratio = w1off / (w0off * 0.5 + w1off);
    vec2 sample0d_texel_offset = vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 mirror_x = vec2(-1., 1.);
    vec2 mirror_y = vec2(1., -1.);
    vec2 mirror_xy = vec2(-1., -1.);
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_x = dxdy * mirror_x;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_y = dxdy * mirror_y;
    vec2 dxdy_mirror_xy = dxdy * mirror_xy;
    vec3 sample0a = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_xy * sample0d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_y * sample0d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0c = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy_mirror_x * sample0d_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0d = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + dxdy * sample0d_texel_offset).rgb;
    return 0.25 * (sample0a + sample0b + sample0c + sample0d);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur12x12shared(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, vec4 quad_vector, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0off = 1.;
    float w0_5off = exp(-(0.5 * 0.5) * denom_inv);
    float w1off = exp(-(1. * 1.) * denom_inv);
    float w1_5off = exp(-(1.5 * 1.5) * denom_inv);
    float w2off = exp(-(2. * 2.) * denom_inv);
    float w2_5off = exp(-(2.5 * 2.5) * denom_inv);
    float w3_5off = exp(-(3.5 * 3.5) * denom_inv);
    float w4_5off = exp(-(4.5 * 4.5) * denom_inv);
    float w5_5off = exp(-(5.5 * 5.5) * denom_inv);
    float texel0to1ratio = mix(w1_5off / (w0_5off + w1_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel2to3ratio = mix(w3_5off / (w2_5off + w3_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel4to5ratio = mix(w5_5off / (w4_5off + w5_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel0to1ratio_nearest = w1off / (w0off + w1off);
    float texel1to2ratio_nearest = w2off / (w1off + w2off);
    vec2 sample0curr_texel_offset = vec2(0., 0.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjx_texel_offset = vec2(-1., 0.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjy_texel_offset = vec2(0., -1.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0diag_texel_offset = vec2(-1., -1.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample1_texel_offset = vec2(2., 0.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample2_texel_offset = vec2(4., 0.) + vec2(texel4to5ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample3_texel_offset = vec2(0., 2.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample4_texel_offset = vec2(2., 2.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample5_texel_offset = vec2(4., 2.) + vec2(texel4to5ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample6_texel_offset = vec2(0., 4.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel4to5ratio);
    vec2 sample7_texel_offset = vec2(2., 4.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel4to5ratio);
    vec2 sample8_texel_offset = vec2(4., 4.) + vec2(texel4to5ratio, texel4to5ratio);
    float w8diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-6., -6.), vec2(-6., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., -6.), vec2(-6. + 1., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6., -6. + 1.), vec2(-6., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., -6. + 1.), vec2(-6. + 1., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w7diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -6.), vec2(-4., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -6.), vec2(-4. + 1., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -6. + 1.), vec2(-4., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -6. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -6.), vec2(-2., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -6.), vec2(-2. + 1., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -6. + 1.), vec2(-2., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -6. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -6.), vec2(0., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -6.), vec2(0. + 1., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -6. + 1.), vec2(0., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -6. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w7adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -6.), vec2(2., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -6.), vec2(2. + 1., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -6. + 1.), vec2(2., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -6. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w8adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(4., -6.), vec2(4., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -6.), vec2(4. + 1., -6.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., -6. + 1.), vec2(4., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -6. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., -6. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w5diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-6., -4.), vec2(-6., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., -4.), vec2(-6. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6., -4. + 1.), vec2(-6., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(-6. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -4.), vec2(-4., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -4.), vec2(-4. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -4. + 1.), vec2(-4., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -4.), vec2(-2., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -4.), vec2(-2. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -4. + 1.), vec2(-2., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -4.), vec2(0., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -4.), vec2(0. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -4. + 1.), vec2(0., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -4.), vec2(2., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -4.), vec2(2. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -4. + 1.), vec2(2., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w5adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(4., -4.), vec2(4., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -4.), vec2(4. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., -4. + 1.), vec2(4., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-6., -2.), vec2(-6., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., -2.), vec2(-6. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6., -2. + 1.), vec2(-6., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-6. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -2.), vec2(-4., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -2.), vec2(-4. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -2. + 1.), vec2(-4., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2.), vec2(-2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2.), vec2(0., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2.), vec2(0. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2. + 1.), vec2(0., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2.), vec2(2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2.), vec2(2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2. + 1.), vec2(2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(4., -2.), vec2(4., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -2.), vec2(4. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., -2. + 1.), vec2(4., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-6., 0.), vec2(-6., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., 0.), vec2(-6. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6., 0. + 1.), vec2(-6., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-6. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 0.), vec2(-4., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 0.), vec2(-4. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 0. + 1.), vec2(-4., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0.), vec2(-2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0.), vec2(0., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0.), vec2(0. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0. + 1.), vec2(0., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0.), vec2(2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0.), vec2(2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0. + 1.), vec2(2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2curr = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 0.), vec2(4., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 0.), vec2(4. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., 0. + 1.), vec2(4., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w5adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-6., 2.), vec2(-6., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., 2.), vec2(-6. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6., 2. + 1.), vec2(-6., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-6. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 2.), vec2(-4., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 2.), vec2(-4. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 2. + 1.), vec2(-4., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2.), vec2(-2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2.), vec2(0., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2.), vec2(0. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2. + 1.), vec2(0., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2.), vec2(2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2.), vec2(2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2. + 1.), vec2(2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w5curr = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 2.), vec2(4., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 2.), vec2(4. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., 2. + 1.), vec2(4., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w8adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-6., 4.), vec2(-6., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., 4.), vec2(-6. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6., 4. + 1.), vec2(-6., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-6. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(-6. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w7adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 4.), vec2(-4., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 4.), vec2(-4. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 4. + 1.), vec2(-4., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 4.), vec2(-2., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 4.), vec2(-2. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 4. + 1.), vec2(-2., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 4.), vec2(0., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 4.), vec2(0. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 4. + 1.), vec2(0., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w7curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 4.), vec2(2., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 4.), vec2(2. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 4. + 1.), vec2(2., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w8curr = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 4.), vec2(4., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 4.), vec2(4. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., 4. + 1.), vec2(4., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    vec4 w0 = vec4(w0curr, w0adjx, w0adjy, w0diag);
    vec4 w1 = vec4(w1curr, w1adjx, w1adjy, w1diag);
    vec4 w2 = vec4(w2curr, w2adjx, w2adjy, w2diag);
    vec4 w3 = vec4(w3curr, w3adjx, w3adjy, w3diag);
    vec4 w4 = vec4(w4curr, w4adjx, w4adjy, w4diag);
    vec4 w5 = vec4(w5curr, w5adjx, w5adjy, w5diag);
    vec4 w6 = vec4(w6curr, w6adjx, w6adjy, w6diag);
    vec4 w7 = vec4(w7curr, w7adjx, w7adjy, w7diag);
    vec4 w8 = vec4(w8curr, w8adjx, w8adjy, w8diag);
    vec4 weight_sum4 = w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5 + w6 + w7 + w8;
    vec2 weight_sum2 = weight_sum4.xy + weight_sum4.zw;
    float weight_sum = weight_sum2.x + weight_sum2.y;
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / weight_sum;
    vec2 dxdy_curr = dxdy * quad_vector.xy;
    vec3 sample0curr = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0curr_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjx = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjx_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjy = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjy_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0diag = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0diag_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample1_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample2curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample2_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample3curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample3_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample4curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample4_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample5curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample5_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample6curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample6_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample7curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample7_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample8curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample8_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag;
    vec3 sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag;
    vec3 sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag;
    vec3 sample4adjx, sample4adjy, sample4diag;
    vec3 sample5adjx, sample5adjy, sample5diag;
    vec3 sample6adjx, sample6adjy, sample6diag;
    vec3 sample7adjx, sample7adjy, sample7diag;
    vec3 sample8adjx, sample8adjy, sample8diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample1curr, sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample2curr, sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample3curr, sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample4curr, sample4adjx, sample4adjy, sample4diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample5curr, sample5adjx, sample5adjy, sample5diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample6curr, sample6adjx, sample6adjy, sample6diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample7curr, sample7adjx, sample7adjy, sample7diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample8curr, sample8adjx, sample8adjy, sample8diag);
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += mat4x3(sample0curr, sample0adjx, sample0adjy, sample0diag) * w0;
    sum += mat4x3(sample1curr, sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag) * w1;
    sum += mat4x3(sample2curr, sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag) * w2;
    sum += mat4x3(sample3curr, sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag) * w3;
    sum += mat4x3(sample4curr, sample4adjx, sample4adjy, sample4diag) * w4;
    sum += mat4x3(sample5curr, sample5adjx, sample5adjy, sample5diag) * w5;
    sum += mat4x3(sample6curr, sample6adjx, sample6adjy, sample6diag) * w6;
    sum += mat4x3(sample7curr, sample7adjx, sample7adjy, sample7diag) * w7;
    sum += mat4x3(sample8curr, sample8adjx, sample8adjy, sample8diag) * w8;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur10x10shared(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, vec4 quad_vector, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0off = 1.;
    float w0_5off = exp(-(0.5 * 0.5) * denom_inv);
    float w1off = exp(-(1. * 1.) * denom_inv);
    float w1_5off = exp(-(1.5 * 1.5) * denom_inv);
    float w2off = exp(-(2. * 2.) * denom_inv);
    float w2_5off = exp(-(2.5 * 2.5) * denom_inv);
    float w3_5off = exp(-(3.5 * 3.5) * denom_inv);
    float w4_5off = exp(-(4.5 * 4.5) * denom_inv);
    float w5_5off = exp(-(5.5 * 5.5) * denom_inv);
    float texel0to1ratio = mix(w1_5off / (w0_5off + w1_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel2to3ratio = mix(w3_5off / (w2_5off + w3_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel4to5ratio = mix(w5_5off / (w4_5off + w5_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel0to1ratio_nearest = w1off / (w0off + w1off);
    float texel1to2ratio_nearest = w2off / (w1off + w2off);
    vec2 sample0curr_texel_offset = vec2(0., 0.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjx_texel_offset = vec2(-1., 0.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjy_texel_offset = vec2(0., -1.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0diag_texel_offset = vec2(-1., -1.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample1_texel_offset = vec2(2., 0.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample2_texel_offset = vec2(4., 0.) + vec2(texel4to5ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample3_texel_offset = vec2(0., 2.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample4_texel_offset = vec2(2., 2.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample5_texel_offset = vec2(4., 2.) + vec2(texel4to5ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample6_texel_offset = vec2(0., 4.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel4to5ratio);
    vec2 sample7_texel_offset = vec2(2., 4.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel4to5ratio);
    vec2 sample8_texel_offset = vec2(4., 4.) + vec2(texel4to5ratio, texel4to5ratio);
    float w4diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -4.), vec2(-4., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -4.), vec2(-4. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -4. + 1.), vec2(-4., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -4.), vec2(-2., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -4.), vec2(-2. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -4. + 1.), vec2(-2., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -4.), vec2(0., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -4.), vec2(0. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -4. + 1.), vec2(0., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -4.), vec2(2., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -4.), vec2(2. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -4. + 1.), vec2(2., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w5adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(4., -4.), vec2(4., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -4.), vec2(4. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., -4. + 1.), vec2(4., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -2.), vec2(-4., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -2.), vec2(-4. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -2. + 1.), vec2(-4., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2.), vec2(-2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2.), vec2(0., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2.), vec2(0. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2. + 1.), vec2(0., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2.), vec2(2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2.), vec2(2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2. + 1.), vec2(2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(4., -2.), vec2(4., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -2.), vec2(4. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., -2. + 1.), vec2(4., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 0.), vec2(-4., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 0.), vec2(-4. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 0. + 1.), vec2(-4., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0.), vec2(-2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0.), vec2(0., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0.), vec2(0. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0. + 1.), vec2(0., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0.), vec2(2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0.), vec2(2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0. + 1.), vec2(2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2curr = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 0.), vec2(4., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 0.), vec2(4. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., 0. + 1.), vec2(4., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 2.), vec2(-4., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 2.), vec2(-4. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 2. + 1.), vec2(-4., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2.), vec2(-2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2.), vec2(0., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2.), vec2(0. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2. + 1.), vec2(0., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w4curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2.), vec2(2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2.), vec2(2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2. + 1.), vec2(2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w5curr = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 2.), vec2(4., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 2.), vec2(4. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., 2. + 1.), vec2(4., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w7adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 4.), vec2(-4., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 4.), vec2(-4. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 4. + 1.), vec2(-4., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 4.), vec2(-2., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 4.), vec2(-2. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 4. + 1.), vec2(-2., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w6curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 4.), vec2(0., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 4.), vec2(0. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 4. + 1.), vec2(0., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w7curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 4.), vec2(2., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 4.), vec2(2. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 4. + 1.), vec2(2., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w8curr = exp(-dot(vec2(4., 4.), vec2(4., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 4.), vec2(4. + 1., 4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4., 4. + 1.), vec2(4., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(4. + 1., 4. + 1.), vec2(4. + 1., 4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0curr + w1curr + w2curr + w3curr + w4curr + w5curr + w6curr + w7curr + w8curr + w0adjx + w1adjx + w3adjx + w4adjx + w6adjx + w7adjx + w0adjy + w1adjy + w2adjy + w3adjy + w4adjy + w5adjy + w0diag + w1diag + w3diag + w4diag);
    vec4 w0 = vec4(w0curr, w0adjx, w0adjy, w0diag);
    vec4 w1 = vec4(w1curr, w1adjx, w1adjy, w1diag);
    vec4 w3 = vec4(w3curr, w3adjx, w3adjy, w3diag);
    vec4 w4 = vec4(w4curr, w4adjx, w4adjy, w4diag);
    vec4 w2and5 = vec4(w2curr, w2adjy, w5curr, w5adjy);
    vec4 w6and7 = vec4(w6curr, w6adjx, w7curr, w7adjx);
    vec2 dxdy_curr = dxdy * quad_vector.xy;
    vec3 sample0curr = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0curr_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjx = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjx_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjy = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjy_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0diag = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0diag_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample1_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample2curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample2_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample3curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample3_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample4curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample4_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample5curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample5_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample6curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample6_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample7curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample7_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample8curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample8_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag;
    vec3 sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag;
    vec3 sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag;
    vec3 sample4adjx, sample4adjy, sample4diag;
    vec3 sample5adjx, sample5adjy, sample5diag;
    vec3 sample6adjx, sample6adjy, sample6diag;
    vec3 sample7adjx, sample7adjy, sample7diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample1curr, sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample2curr, sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample3curr, sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample4curr, sample4adjx, sample4adjy, sample4diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample5curr, sample5adjx, sample5adjy, sample5diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample6curr, sample6adjx, sample6adjy, sample6diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample7curr, sample7adjx, sample7adjy, sample7diag);
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += mat4x3(sample0curr, sample0adjx, sample0adjy, sample0diag) * w0;
    sum += mat4x3(sample1curr, sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag) * w1;
    sum += mat4x3(sample3curr, sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag) * w3;
    sum += mat4x3(sample4curr, sample4adjx, sample4adjy, sample4diag) * w4;
    sum += mat4x3(sample2curr, sample2adjy, sample5curr, sample5adjy) * w2and5;
    sum += mat4x3(sample6curr, sample6adjx, sample7curr, sample7adjx) * w6and7;
    sum += w8curr * sample8curr;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur8x8shared(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, vec4 quad_vector, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0off = 1.;
    float w0_5off = exp(-(0.5 * 0.5) * denom_inv);
    float w1off = exp(-(1. * 1.) * denom_inv);
    float w1_5off = exp(-(1.5 * 1.5) * denom_inv);
    float w2off = exp(-(2. * 2.) * denom_inv);
    float w2_5off = exp(-(2.5 * 2.5) * denom_inv);
    float w3_5off = exp(-(3.5 * 3.5) * denom_inv);
    float texel0to1ratio = mix(w1_5off / (w0_5off + w1_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel2to3ratio = mix(w3_5off / (w2_5off + w3_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel0to1ratio_nearest = w1off / (w0off + w1off);
    float texel1to2ratio_nearest = w2off / (w1off + w2off);
    vec2 sample0curr_texel_offset = vec2(0., 0.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjx_texel_offset = vec2(-1., 0.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjy_texel_offset = vec2(0., -1.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0diag_texel_offset = vec2(-1., -1.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample1_texel_offset = vec2(2., 0.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample2_texel_offset = vec2(0., 2.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample3_texel_offset = vec2(2., 2.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    float w3diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -4.), vec2(-4., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -4.), vec2(-4. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -4. + 1.), vec2(-4., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -4.), vec2(-2., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -4.), vec2(-2. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -4. + 1.), vec2(-2., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -4.), vec2(0., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -4.), vec2(0. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -4. + 1.), vec2(0., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -4.), vec2(2., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -4.), vec2(2. + 1., -4.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -4. + 1.), vec2(2., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -4. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -4. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -2.), vec2(-4., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -2.), vec2(-4. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., -2. + 1.), vec2(-4., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2.), vec2(-2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2.), vec2(0., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2.), vec2(0. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2. + 1.), vec2(0., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2.), vec2(2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2.), vec2(2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2. + 1.), vec2(2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 0.), vec2(-4., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 0.), vec2(-4. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 0. + 1.), vec2(-4., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0.), vec2(-2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0.), vec2(0., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0.), vec2(0. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0. + 1.), vec2(0., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0.), vec2(2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0.), vec2(2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0. + 1.), vec2(2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 2.), vec2(-4., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 2.), vec2(-4. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4., 2. + 1.), vec2(-4., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-4. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-4. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2.), vec2(-2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2.), vec2(0., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2.), vec2(0. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2. + 1.), vec2(0., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2.), vec2(2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2.), vec2(2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2. + 1.), vec2(2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    vec4 w0 = vec4(w0curr, w0adjx, w0adjy, w0diag);
    vec4 w1 = vec4(w1curr, w1adjx, w1adjy, w1diag);
    vec4 w2 = vec4(w2curr, w2adjx, w2adjy, w2diag);
    vec4 w3 = vec4(w3curr, w3adjx, w3adjy, w3diag);
    vec4 weight_sum4 = w0 + w1 + w2 + w3;
    vec2 weight_sum2 = weight_sum4.xy + weight_sum4.zw;
    float weight_sum = weight_sum2.x + weight_sum2.y;
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / weight_sum;
    vec2 dxdy_curr = dxdy * quad_vector.xy;
    vec3 sample0curr = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0curr_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjx = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjx_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjy = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjy_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0diag = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0diag_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample1_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample2curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample2_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample3curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample3_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag;
    vec3 sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag;
    vec3 sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample1curr, sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample2curr, sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample3curr, sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag);
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += mat4x3(sample0curr, sample0adjx, sample0adjy, sample0diag) * w0;
    sum += mat4x3(sample1curr, sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag) * w1;
    sum += mat4x3(sample2curr, sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag) * w2;
    sum += mat4x3(sample3curr, sample3adjx, sample3adjy, sample3diag) * w3;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur6x6shared(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, vec4 quad_vector, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0off = 1.;
    float w0_5off = exp(-(0.5 * 0.5) * denom_inv);
    float w1off = exp(-(1. * 1.) * denom_inv);
    float w1_5off = exp(-(1.5 * 1.5) * denom_inv);
    float w2off = exp(-(2. * 2.) * denom_inv);
    float w2_5off = exp(-(2.5 * 2.5) * denom_inv);
    float w3_5off = exp(-(3.5 * 3.5) * denom_inv);
    float texel0to1ratio = mix(w1_5off / (w0_5off + w1_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel2to3ratio = mix(w3_5off / (w2_5off + w3_5off), 0.5, fragment_error_blurring);
    float texel0to1ratio_nearest = w1off / (w0off + w1off);
    float texel1to2ratio_nearest = w2off / (w1off + w2off);
    vec2 sample0curr_texel_offset = vec2(0., 0.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjx_texel_offset = vec2(-1., 0.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, texel0to1ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0adjy_texel_offset = vec2(0., -1.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample0diag_texel_offset = vec2(-1., -1.) + vec2(-texel1to2ratio_nearest, -texel1to2ratio_nearest);
    vec2 sample1_texel_offset = vec2(2., 0.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel0to1ratio);
    vec2 sample2_texel_offset = vec2(0., 2.) + vec2(texel0to1ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    vec2 sample3_texel_offset = vec2(2., 2.) + vec2(texel2to3ratio, texel2to3ratio);
    float w0diag = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2.), vec2(-2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2.), vec2(0., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2.), vec2(0. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., -2. + 1.), vec2(0., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1adjy = exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2.), vec2(2., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2.), vec2(2. + 1., -2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., -2. + 1.), vec2(2., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., -2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0.), vec2(-2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w0curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0.), vec2(0., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0.), vec2(0. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 0. + 1.), vec2(0., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w1curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0.), vec2(2., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0.), vec2(2. + 1., 0.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 0. + 1.), vec2(2., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 0. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2adjx = exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2.), vec2(-2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(-2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w2curr = exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2.), vec2(0., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2.), vec2(0. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0., 2. + 1.), vec2(0., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(0. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float w3curr = exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2.), vec2(2., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2.), vec2(2. + 1., 2.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2., 2. + 1.), vec2(2., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv) + exp(-dot(vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.), vec2(2. + 1., 2. + 1.)) * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0curr + w1curr + w2curr + w3curr + w0adjx + w2adjx + w0adjy + w1adjy + w0diag);
    vec4 w0 = vec4(w0curr, w0adjx, w0adjy, w0diag);
    vec2 dxdy_curr = dxdy * quad_vector.xy;
    vec3 sample0curr = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0curr_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjx = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjx_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0adjy = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0adjy_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample0diag = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv.xy + dxdy_curr * sample0diag_texel_offset).rgb;
    vec3 sample1curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample1_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample2curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample2_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample3curr = fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(tex, tex_uv + fragment_uv2_to_uv4(dxdy_curr * sample3_texel_offset)).rgb;
    vec3 sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag;
    vec3 sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample1curr, sample1adjx, sample1adjy, sample1diag);
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, sample2curr, sample2adjx, sample2adjy, sample2diag);
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += mat4x3(sample0curr, sample0adjx, sample0adjy, sample0diag) * w0;
    sum += w1curr * sample1curr + w1adjy * sample1adjy + w2curr * sample2curr + w2adjx * sample2adjx + w3curr * sample3curr;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}
