// PATCHED (fix 10b): cubic B-spline reconstruction, 4 bilinear taps
// (Sigg-Hadwiger). Bilinear reconstruction of a 320x240 glow buffer is
// piecewise LINEAR: its slope jumps at every texel boundary, and at 9-12
// output pixels per texel those breaks are what reads as a hard-edged halo.
// The B-spline is C2 and does not overshoot, and its ~half-texel extra
// low-pass is exactly what a diffusion term wants. tex_size is (size, 1/size).
vec3 royale_tex2D_bspline(sampler2D tex, vec2 uv, vec4 tex_size) {
    vec2 pos = uv * tex_size.xy;
    vec2 tc = floor(pos - 0.5) + 0.5;
    vec2 f = pos - tc;
    vec2 f2 = f * f;
    vec2 f3 = f2 * f;
    vec2 w0 = (1. / 6.) * (-f3 + 3. * f2 - 3. * f + 1.);
    vec2 w1 = (1. / 6.) * (3. * f3 - 6. * f2 + 4.);
    vec2 w2 = (1. / 6.) * (-3. * f3 + 3. * f2 + 3. * f + 1.);
    vec2 w3 = (1. / 6.) * f3;
    vec2 s0 = w0 + w1;
    vec2 s1 = w2 + w3;
    vec2 uv0 = (tc - 1. + w1 / s0) * tex_size.zw;
    vec2 uv1 = (tc + 1. + w3 / s1) * tex_size.zw;
    return s0.y * (s0.x * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, vec2(uv0.x, uv0.y)).rgb +
                   s1.x * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, vec2(uv1.x, uv0.y)).rgb) +
           s1.y * (s0.x * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, vec2(uv0.x, uv1.y)).rgb +
                   s1.x * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, vec2(uv1.x, uv1.y)).rgb);
}

// blur5fast with every tap reconstructed by B-spline instead of bilinear. Same
// weights and same tap offsets as fragment_tex2Dblur5fast, so halation_bicubic
// changes the reconstruction and never the radius. It is a 2D reconstruction,
// so although this pass only blurs vertically it also removes the horizontal
// tents -- which matters, because _PASS_4 is what the horizontal pass reads.
vec3 royale_tex2Dblur5fast_bspline(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, vec4 tex_size, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2));
    float w12 = w1 + w2;
    float w12_ratio = w2 / w12;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w12 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv - (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy, tex_size);
    sum += w0 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv, tex_size);
    sum += w12 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv + (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy, tex_size);
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

// SUPER: blur9fast with B-spline reconstruction, transcribed from
// crt-royale-final.glsl. Same weights and same tap offsets as
// fragment_tex2Dblur9fast, so halation_bicubic changes the reconstruction and
// never the radius.
vec3 royale_tex2Dblur9fast_bspline(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, vec4 tex_size, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4));
    float w12 = w1 + w2;
    float w34 = w3 + w4;
    float w12_ratio = w2 / w12;
    float w34_ratio = w4 / w34;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w34 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv - (3. + w34_ratio) * dxdy, tex_size);
    sum += w12 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv - (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy, tex_size);
    sum += w0 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv, tex_size);
    sum += w12 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv + (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy, tex_size);
    sum += w34 * royale_tex2D_bspline(tex, tex_uv + (3. + w34_ratio) * dxdy, tex_size);
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

void fragment_main() {
    // PATCHED (fix 10b): Source is BLOOM_APPROX, 320x240, and this pass reads it
    // across a magnification. That read is where the tents come from.
    // SUPER: 5-tap (kurozumi) vs 9-tap (crt-royale) halation blur. Different
    // std_dev as well as different span -- see the header. Both functions and
    // both std_devs were already emitted into this pass by the converter.
    vec3 color;
    if (royale_blur_taps >= 7.) {
        if (halation_bicubic > 0.5) {
            color = royale_tex2Dblur9fast_bspline(Source, tex_uv, blur_dxdy, params.SourceSize, fragment_blur9_std_dev);
        } else {
            color = fragment_tex2Dblur9fast(Source, tex_uv, blur_dxdy);
        }
    } else if (halation_bicubic > 0.5) {
        color = royale_tex2Dblur5fast_bspline(Source, tex_uv, blur_dxdy, params.SourceSize, fragment_blur5_std_dev);
    } else {
        color = fragment_tex2Dblur5fast(Source, tex_uv, blur_dxdy);
    }
    FragColor = fragment_encode_output(vec4(color, 1.));
}

vec4 hook() {
    vertex_main();
    fragment_main();
    return FragColor;
}


//!HOOK MAIN
//!COMPONENTS 4
//!DESC blur5fast-horizontal.slang
//!WIDTH _PASS_4.width 1 *
//!HEIGHT _PASS_4.height 1 *
//!SAVE HALATION_BLUR
//!BIND MAIN_RGB
//!BIND _PASS_4
//!BIND HOOKED

vec4 vertex_gl_Position;
struct _params_ {
    vec4 SourceSize;
    vec4 OriginalSize;
    vec4 OutputSize;
    uint FrameCount;
} params = _params_(vec4(_PASS_4_size, _PASS_4_pt), vec4(MAIN_RGB_size, MAIN_RGB_pt), vec4(_PASS_4_size, _PASS_4_pt), uint(frame));
// PATCHED (fix 10a): must match blur5fast-vertical's WIDTH / HEIGHT multiplier.
#define ROYALE_HALATION_RES_SCALE 3.0
struct _global_ {
    mat4 MVP;
} global = _global_(mat4(1.));
vec4 Position = vec4(HOOKED_pos, 0., 1.);
vec2 TexCoord = HOOKED_pos;
vec2 tex_uv;
vec2 blur_dxdy;
void vertex_main() {
    vertex_gl_Position = global.MVP * Position;
    tex_uv = TexCoord;
    vec2 dxdy_scale = params.SourceSize.xy * params.OutputSize.zw;
    vec2 dxdy = dxdy_scale * params.SourceSize.zw;
    // PATCHED (fix 10a): Source here is _PASS_4, which renders at
    // ROYALE_HALATION_RES_SCALE x BLOOM_APPROX, so dxdy is that fraction of a
    // BLOOM_APPROX texel. Undo it so the horizontal radius matches the vertical
    // one. Must match the multiplier in blur5fast-vertical's WIDTH / HEIGHT
    // directives.
    blur_dxdy = vec2(dxdy.x * diffusion_blur_scale * ROYALE_HALATION_RES_SCALE, 0.);
}

vec4 FragColor;
#define Source _PASS_4_raw
float fragment_ntsc_gamma = 2.2;
float fragment_pal_gamma = 2.8;
float fragment_crt_reference_gamma_high = 2.5;
float fragment_crt_reference_gamma_low = 2.35;
float fragment_lcd_reference_gamma = 2.5;
float fragment_crt_office_gamma = 2.2;
float fragment_lcd_office_gamma = 2.2;
bool fragment_assume_opaque_alpha = false;
float fragment_get_crt_gamma() {
    return fragment_crt_reference_gamma_high;
}

float fragment_get_gba_gamma() {
    return 3.5;
}

float fragment_get_lcd_gamma() {
    return fragment_lcd_office_gamma;
}

float fragment_get_intermediate_gamma() {
    return fragment_ntsc_gamma;
}

float fragment_get_input_gamma() {
    return fragment_ntsc_gamma;
}

float fragment_get_output_gamma() {
    return fragment_ntsc_gamma;
}

bool fragment_linearize_input = false;
float fragment_get_pass_input_gamma() {
    return 1.;
}

bool fragment_gamma_encode_output = false;
float fragment_get_pass_output_gamma() {
    return 1.;
}

bool fragment_gamma_aware_bilinear = !fragment_linearize_input;
vec4 fragment_encode_output(vec4 color) {
    if (fragment_gamma_encode_output) {
        if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / fragment_get_pass_output_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / fragment_get_pass_output_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 fragment_decode_input(vec4 color) {
    if (fragment_linearize_input) {
        if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(fragment_get_pass_input_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(fragment_get_pass_input_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 fragment_decode_gamma_input(vec4 color, vec3 fragment_gamma) {
    if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, fragment_gamma), 1.);
    } else {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, fragment_gamma), color.a);
    }
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords) {
    return fragment_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords) {
    return fragment_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords.xy));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords, texel_off));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, vec3 fragment_gamma) {
    return fragment_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.), fragment_gamma);
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off, vec3 fragment_gamma) {
    return fragment_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off), fragment_gamma);
}

float fragment_blur3_std_dev = 0.62666017;
float fragment_blur4_std_dev = 0.6617187;
float fragment_blur5_std_dev = 0.9845703;
float fragment_blur6_std_dev = 1.0262696;
float fragment_blur7_std_dev = 1.3610351;
float fragment_blur8_std_dev = 1.4080079;
float fragment_blur9_std_dev = 1.7533203;
float fragment_blur10_std_dev = 1.8047851;
float fragment_blur11_std_dev = 2.1598632;
float fragment_blur12_std_dev = 2.2152343;
float fragment_blur17_std_dev = 3.455356;
float fragment_blur25_std_dev = 5.3409576;
float fragment_blur31_std_dev = 6.8648806;
float fragment_blur43_std_dev = 10.185205;
float fragment_error_blurring = 0.5;
vec4 fragment_get_quad_vector_naive(vec4 output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy) {
    vec4 pixel_odd = fract(output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy * 0.5) * 2.;
    vec4 quad_vector = pixel_odd * 2. - vec4(1.);
    return quad_vector;
}

vec4 fragment_get_quad_vector(vec4 output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy) {
    vec4 quad_vector_guess = fragment_get_quad_vector_naive(output_pixel_num_wrt_uvxy);
    vec2 odd_start_mirror = 0.5 * vec2(dFdx(quad_vector_guess.z), dFdy(quad_vector_guess.w));
    return quad_vector_guess * odd_start_mirror.xyxy;
}

vec4 fragment_get_quad_vector(vec2 output_pixel_num_wrt_uv) {
    vec2 screen_uv_mirror = vec2(dFdx(output_pixel_num_wrt_uv.x), dFdy(output_pixel_num_wrt_uv.y));
    vec2 pixel_odd_wrt_uv = fract(output_pixel_num_wrt_uv * 0.5) * 2.;
    vec2 quad_vector_uv_guess = (pixel_odd_wrt_uv - vec2(0.5)) * 2.;
    vec2 quad_vector_screen_guess = quad_vector_uv_guess * screen_uv_mirror;
    vec2 odd_start_mirror = 0.5 * vec2(dFdx(quad_vector_screen_guess.x), dFdy(quad_vector_screen_guess.y));
    vec4 quad_vector_guess = vec4(quad_vector_uv_guess, quad_vector_screen_guess);
    return quad_vector_guess * odd_start_mirror.xyxy;
}

void fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, vec4 curr, out vec4 adjx, out vec4 adjy, out vec4 diag) {
    adjx = curr - dFdx(curr) * quad_vector.z;
    adjy = curr - dFdy(curr) * quad_vector.w;
    diag = adjx - dFdy(adjx) * quad_vector.w;
}

void fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, vec3 curr, out vec3 adjx, out vec3 adjy, out vec3 diag) {
    adjx = curr - dFdx(curr) * quad_vector.z;
    adjy = curr - dFdy(curr) * quad_vector.w;
    diag = adjx - dFdy(adjx) * quad_vector.w;
}

void fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, vec2 curr, out vec2 adjx, out vec2 adjy, out vec2 diag) {
    adjx = curr - dFdx(curr) * quad_vector.z;
    adjy = curr - dFdy(curr) * quad_vector.w;
    diag = adjx - dFdy(adjx) * quad_vector.w;
}

vec4 fragment_quad_gather(vec4 quad_vector, float curr) {
    vec4 all = vec4(curr);
    all.y = all.x - dFdx(all.x) * quad_vector.z;
    all.zw = all.xy - dFdy(all.xy) * quad_vector.w;
    return all;
}

vec4 fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, vec4 curr) {
    vec4 adjx, adjy, diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr, adjx, adjy, diag);
    return curr + adjx + adjy + diag;
}

vec3 fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, vec3 curr) {
    vec3 adjx, adjy, diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr, adjx, adjy, diag);
    return curr + adjx + adjy + diag;
}

vec2 fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, vec2 curr) {
    vec2 adjx, adjy, diag;
    fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr, adjx, adjy, diag);
    return curr + adjx + adjy + diag;
}

float fragment_quad_gather_sum(vec4 quad_vector, float curr) {
    vec4 all_values = fragment_quad_gather(quad_vector, curr);
    return all_values.x + all_values.y + all_values.z + all_values.w;
}

bool fragment_fine_derivatives_working(vec4 quad_vector, vec4 curr) {
    vec4 ddx_curr = dFdx(curr);
    vec4 ddy_curr = dFdy(curr);
    vec4 adjx = curr - ddx_curr * quad_vector.z;
    vec4 adjy = curr - ddy_curr * quad_vector.w;
    bool ddy_different = any(bvec4(ddy_curr.x != dFdy(adjx).x, ddy_curr.y != dFdy(adjx).y, ddy_curr.z != dFdy(adjx).z, ddy_curr.w != dFdy(adjx).w));
    bool ddx_different = any(bvec4(ddx_curr.x != dFdx(adjy).x, ddx_curr.y != dFdx(adjy).y, ddx_curr.z != dFdx(adjy).z, ddx_curr.w != dFdx(adjy).w));
    return any(bvec2(ddy_different, ddx_different));
}

bool fragment_fine_derivatives_working_fast(vec4 quad_vector, float curr) {
    float ddx_curr = dFdx(curr);
    float ddy_curr = dFdy(curr);
    float adjx = curr - ddx_curr * quad_vector.z;
    return ddy_curr != dFdy(adjx);
}

vec4 fragment_erf6(vec4 x) {
    vec4 one = vec4(1.);
    vec4 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec4 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec4 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec3 fragment_erf6(vec3 x) {
    vec3 one = vec3(1.);
    vec3 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec3 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec3 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec2 fragment_erf6(vec2 x) {
    vec2 one = vec2(1.);
    vec2 sign_x = sign(x);
    vec2 t = one / (one + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    vec2 result = one - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

float fragment_erf6(float x) {
    float sign_x = sign(x);
    float t = 1. / (1. + 0.47047 * abs(x));
    float result = 1. - t * (0.3480242 + t * (-0.0958798 + t * 0.7478556)) * exp(-(x * x));
    return result * sign_x;
}

vec4 fragment_gamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 g = vec4(1.1290683);
    vec4 c0 = vec4(0.81091195);
    vec4 c1 = vec4(0.48083547);
    vec4 e = vec4(2.7182817);
    vec4 sph = s + vec4(0.5);
    vec4 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec4(1.));
    vec4 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_gamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 g = vec3(1.1290683);
    vec3 c0 = vec3(0.81091195);
    vec3 c1 = vec3(0.48083547);
    vec3 e = vec3(2.7182817);
    vec3 sph = s + vec3(0.5);
    vec3 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec3(1.));
    vec3 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec2 fragment_gamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 g = vec2(1.1290683);
    vec2 c0 = vec2(0.81091195);
    vec2 c1 = vec2(0.48083547);
    vec2 e = vec2(2.7182817);
    vec2 sph = s + vec2(0.5);
    vec2 lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + vec2(1.));
    vec2 base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

float fragment_gamma_impl(float s, float s_inv) {
    float g = 1.1290683;
    float c0 = 0.81091195;
    float c1 = 0.48083547;
    float e = 2.7182817;
    float sph = s + 0.5;
    float lanczos_sum = c0 + c1 / (s + 1.);
    float base = (sph + g) / e;
    return pow(base, sph) * lanczos_sum * s_inv;
}

vec4 fragment_gamma(vec4 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec4(1.) / s);
}

vec3 fragment_gamma(vec3 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec3(1.) / s);
}

vec2 fragment_gamma(vec2 s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, vec2(1.) / s);
}

float fragment_gamma(float s) {
    return fragment_gamma_impl(s, 1. / s);
}

vec4 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv) {
    vec4 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec4 sum = s_inv;
    vec4 z_sq = z * z;
    vec4 denom1 = s + vec4(1.);
    vec4 denom2 = 2. * s + vec4(4.);
    vec4 denom3 = 6. * s + vec4(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec3 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv) {
    vec3 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec3 sum = s_inv;
    vec3 z_sq = z * z;
    vec3 denom1 = s + vec3(1.);
    vec3 denom2 = 2. * s + vec3(4.);
    vec3 denom3 = 6. * s + vec3(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec2 fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv) {
    vec2 scale = pow(z, s);
    vec2 sum = s_inv;
    vec2 z_sq = z * z;
    vec2 denom1 = s + vec2(1.);
    vec2 denom2 = 2. * s + vec2(4.);
    vec2 denom3 = 6. * s + vec2(18.);
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

float fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv) {
    float scale = pow(z, s);
    float sum = s_inv;
    float z_sq = z * z;
    float denom1 = s + 1.;
    float denom2 = 2. * s + 4.;
    float denom3 = 6. * s + 18.;
    sum -= z / denom1;
    sum += z_sq / denom2;
    sum -= z * z_sq / denom3;
    return scale * sum;
}

vec4 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec4 denom = vec4(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec4(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec4(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec4(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec4(1.) + z - s + (s - vec4(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec3 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec3 denom = vec3(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec3(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec3(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec3(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec3(1.) + z - s + (s - vec3(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec2 fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    vec2 denom = vec2(7.) + z - s;
    denom = vec2(5.) + z - s + (3. * s - vec2(9.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(3.) + z - s + (2. * s - vec2(4.)) / denom;
    denom = vec2(1.) + z - s + (s - vec2(1.)) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

float fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(float s, float z) {
    float numerator = pow(z, s) * exp(-z);
    float denom = 7. + z - s;
    denom = 5. + z - s + (3. * s - 9.) / denom;
    denom = 3. + z - s + (2. * s - 4.) / denom;
    denom = 1. + z - s + (s - 1.) / denom;
    return numerator / denom;
}

vec4 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec4 s, vec4 z, vec4 s_inv, vec4 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec4 thresh = vec4(0.775075);
    bvec4 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    z_is_large.w = z.w > thresh.w;
    vec4 large_z = vec4(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec4 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec4 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec4(z_is_large) + small_z * vec4(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec3 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec3 s, vec3 z, vec3 s_inv, vec3 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec3 thresh = vec3(0.775075);
    bvec3 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    z_is_large.z = z.z > thresh.z;
    vec3 large_z = vec3(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec3 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec3 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec3(z_is_large) + small_z * vec3(inverse_z_is_large);
}

vec2 fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(vec2 s, vec2 z, vec2 s_inv, vec2 gamma_s_inv) {
    vec2 thresh = vec2(0.775075);
    bvec2 z_is_large;
    z_is_large.x = z.x > thresh.x;
    z_is_large.y = z.y > thresh.y;
    vec2 large_z = vec2(1.) - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    vec2 small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    bvec2 inverse_z_is_large = not(z_is_large);
    return large_z * vec2(z_is_large) + small_z * vec2(inverse_z_is_large);
}

float fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(float s, float z, float s_inv, float gamma_s_inv) {
    float thresh = 0.775075;
    bool z_is_large = z > thresh;
    float large_z = 1. - fragment_uigamma_large_z_impl(s, z) * gamma_s_inv;
    float small_z = fragment_ligamma_small_z_impl(s, z, s_inv) * gamma_s_inv;
    return large_z * float(z_is_large) + small_z * float(!z_is_large);
}

vec4 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec4 s, vec4 z) {
    vec4 s_inv = vec4(1.) / s;
    vec4 gamma_s_inv = vec4(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec3 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec3 s, vec3 z) {
    vec3 s_inv = vec3(1.) / s;
    vec3 gamma_s_inv = vec3(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec2 fragment_normalized_ligamma(vec2 s, vec2 z) {
    vec2 s_inv = vec2(1.) / s;
    vec2 gamma_s_inv = vec2(1.) / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

float fragment_normalized_ligamma(float s, float z) {
    float s_inv = 1. / s;
    float gamma_s_inv = 1. / fragment_gamma_impl(s, s_inv);
    return fragment_normalized_ligamma_impl(s, z, s_inv, gamma_s_inv);
}

vec4 fragment_uv2_to_uv4(vec2 tex_uv) {
    return vec4(tex_uv, 0., 0.);
}

float fragment_get_fast_gaussian_weight_sum_inv(float sigma) {
    return min(exp(exp(0.3483484 / (sigma - 0.08605873))), 0.39933458 / sigma);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur11resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float w5 = exp(-25. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5));
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 5. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 5. * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur9resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4));
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 4. * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur7resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3));
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 3. * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur5resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2));
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 2. * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur3resize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * w1);
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + 1. * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur11fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float w5 = exp(-25. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5));
    float w01 = w0 * 0.5 + w1;
    float w23 = w2 + w3;
    float w45 = w4 + w5;
    float w01_ratio = w1 / w01;
    float w23_ratio = w3 / w23;
    float w45_ratio = w5 / w45;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w45 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (4. + w45_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w45 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (4. + w45_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur9fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4));
    float w12 = w1 + w2;
    float w34 = w3 + w4;
    float w12_ratio = w2 / w12;
    float w34_ratio = w4 / w34;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w34 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (3. + w34_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w12 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w12 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w34 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (3. + w34_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur7fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2 + w3));
    float w01 = w0 * 0.5 + w1;
    float w23 = w2 + w3;
    float w01_ratio = w1 / w01;
    float w23_ratio = w3 / w23;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w01 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w23 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (2. + w23_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur5fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * (w1 + w2));
    float w12 = w1 + w2;
    float w12_ratio = w2 / w12;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w12 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    sum += w12 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (1. + w12_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur3fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = 1. / (w0 + 2. * w1);
    float w01 = w0 * 0.5 + w1;
    float w01_ratio = w1 / w01;
    return 0.5 * (fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb + fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + w01_ratio * dxdy).rgb);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur43fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);

    float w7 = exp(-49. * denom_inv);
    float w8 = exp(-64. * denom_inv);
    float w9 = exp(-81. * denom_inv);
    float w10 = exp(-100. * denom_inv);
    float w11 = exp(-121. * denom_inv);
    float w12 = exp(-144. * denom_inv);
    float w13 = exp(-169. * denom_inv);
    float w14 = exp(-196. * denom_inv);

    float w18 = exp(-324. * denom_inv);
    float w19 = exp(-361. * denom_inv);
    float w20 = exp(-400. * denom_inv);
    float w21 = exp(-441. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = fragment_get_fast_gaussian_weight_sum_inv(sigma);
    float w0_1 = w0 * 0.5 + w1;
    float w2_3 = w2 + w3;
    float w4_5 = w4 + w5;
    float w6_7 = w6 + w7;
    float w8_9 = w8 + w9;
    float w10_11 = w10 + w11;
    float w12_13 = w12 + w13;
    float w14_15 = w14 + w15;
    float w16_17 = w16 + w17;
    float w18_19 = w18 + w19;
    float w20_21 = w20 + w21;
    float w0_1_ratio = w1 / w0_1;
    float w2_3_ratio = w3 / w2_3;
    float w4_5_ratio = w5 / w4_5;
    float w6_7_ratio = w7 / w6_7;
    float w8_9_ratio = w9 / w8_9;
    float w10_11_ratio = w11 / w10_11;
    float w12_13_ratio = w13 / w12_13;
    float w14_15_ratio = w15 / w14_15;
    float w16_17_ratio = w17 / w16_17;
    float w18_19_ratio = w19 / w18_19;
    float w20_21_ratio = w21 / w20_21;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    sum += w20_21 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (20. + w20_21_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w18_19 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (18. + w18_19_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w16_17 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (16. + w16_17_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w14_15 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (14. + w14_15_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w12_13 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (12. + w12_13_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w10_11 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (10. + w10_11_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w8_9 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (8. + w8_9_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w6_7 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (6. + w6_7_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4_5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (4. + w4_5_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2_3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (2. + w2_3_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0_1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - w0_1_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w0_1 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + w0_1_ratio * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w2_3 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (2. + w2_3_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w4_5 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (4. + w4_5_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w6_7 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (6. + w6_7_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w8_9 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (8. + w8_9_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w10_11 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (10. + w10_11_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w12_13 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (12. + w12_13_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w14_15 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (14. + w14_15_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w16_17 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (16. + w16_17_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w18_19 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (18. + w18_19_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w20_21 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + (20. + w20_21_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Dblur17fast(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, vec2 dxdy, float sigma) {
    float denom_inv = 0.5 / (sigma * sigma);
    float w0 = 1.;
    float w1 = exp(-1. * denom_inv);
    float w2 = exp(-4. * denom_inv);
    float w3 = exp(-9. * denom_inv);
    float w4 = exp(-16. * denom_inv);
    float w5 = exp(-25. * denom_inv);
    float w6 = exp(-36. * denom_inv);
    float w7 = exp(-49. * denom_inv);
    float w8 = exp(-64. * denom_inv);
    float weight_sum_inv = fragment_get_fast_gaussian_weight_sum_inv(sigma);
    float w1_2 = w1 + w2;
    float w3_4 = w3 + w4;
    float w5_6 = w5 + w6;
    float w7_8 = w7 + w8;
    float w1_2_ratio = w2 / w1_2;
    float w3_4_ratio = w4 / w3_4;
    float w5_6_ratio = w6 / w5_6;
    float w7_8_ratio = w8 / w7_8;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);

    sum += w3_4 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (3. + w3_4_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
    sum += w1_2 * fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - (1. + w1_2_ratio) * dxdy).rgb;
