// Position-dependent convergence. The stock convergence_offset_* knobs above
// shift a channel uniformly across the whole screen, which no tube does. A real
// set is converged at the CENTRE by the service adjustment and drifts away from
// it, because the three beams take different-length paths through the
// deflection field. This returns the error for RED; blue gets the negation and
// green is the reference, which is the in-line gun order -- R, G, B in a row --
// that every consumer set has used since the early 70s.
//
// THIS EXTENDS THE STOCK KNOBS, it does not sit beside them. The static offsets
// are the order-0 (constant) term of the misconvergence field; what is below is
// the complete order-2 set. One code path: every getter returns base + bias.
//
// THE SHAPE OF THE ERROR IS NOT A FREE CHOICE. Red and blue sit at +d and -d
// either side of green, so the two of them are a MIRROR PAIR about the tube's
// vertical axis, and the yoke and the screen are mirror-symmetric about that
// axis as well. Reflecting the whole system therefore maps the red error onto
// the blue error. Writing D for the red-minus-blue separation, that forces
//
//     D.x EVEN in x        D.y ODD in x
//
// and the horizontal mirror, which does NOT swap the guns, forces
//
//     D.x EVEN in y        D.y ODD in y
//
// Antisymmetry -- blue being exactly the negation of red -- is IMPLIED by that
// parity rather than assumed alongside it: D.x even in x gives err_B.x =
// -err_R.x, and D.y odd in x gives err_B.y = -err_R.y.
//
// Ray-tracing agrees with the algebra. A beam offset +d in x that is heading
// RIGHT sits in the part of the yoke where the pincushion H field has
// dB/dx > 0, so it is over-deflected; the same beam heading LEFT sits where
// dB/dx < 0, so it is UNDER-deflected. Both cases land red displaced the same
// way, which is even in x. The odd alternative amounts to a magnification
// difference between the red and blue rasters, and a mirror-symmetric yoke
// cannot produce one at all: reflecting a set whose red raster is the larger
// gives a set whose BLUE raster is the larger, and that is the same set.
//
// So a RADIAL model -- error growing as r^2, pointing away from centre, red
// splaying outward -- has the wrong parity on both axes. That error is real,
// but it belongs to the yoke-TILT and neck-magnet class, i.e. to
// misADJUSTMENT, and not to the residual a correctly set up self-converging
// yoke leaves behind. What is modelled here is the residual. This was got
// wrong once already, on the first implementation, and corrected 2026-08-05
// after both edges were checked on screen.
//
// The three terms are every second-order term the two mirrors permit:
//
//   H_SIDES   dx += k * p.x^2 -- horizontal misconvergence growing toward the
//             LEFT AND RIGHT edges, the SAME sense at both. Service
//             nomenclature calls this XH, "the edge of X-axis horizontal
//             convergence error". The knob is the value at the edge, where
//             p.x^2 = 1, so no calibration factor is needed.
//
//   H_TOPBOT  dx += k * p.y^2 -- horizontal misconvergence at the TOP AND
//             BOTTOM of a CENTRE VERTICAL line, again the same sense at both.
//             This is YH, one of the residuals a self-converging yoke is
//             trimmed against with wedges. Knob is the edge value likewise.
//
//   V_CORNER  dy  = k * p.x * p.y -- vertical misconvergence, which the odd
//             parity pins to exactly ZERO along both centre lines and makes
//             largest in the CORNERS, flipping sign between adjacent ones.
//             This one is not a design failure but a geometric certainty: the
//             yoke literature notes that once the 3/9 and 6/12 o'clock errors
//             are wound out completely, a residual VERTICAL misconvergence
//             survives in the corner that is independent of the winding and
//             fixed by the geometry of the system. The knob is the corner
//             value, where p.x * p.y = 1.
//
// Note what is deliberately absent: NO vertical error anywhere on the
// horizontal centre line, and none on the vertical centre line either. A model
// that puts error there has the parity wrong.
//
// Both horizontal terms are even, so they ADD identically at all four corners
// and can never null one side of the picture against the other. There is no
// interaction to tune around.
//
// Also absent: COMA, i.e. green against red-and-blue together (HCR in the
// patent literature), which is a real and separately corrected mode. Green is
// on-axis, so the mirror maps it to itself and its own horizontal error is ODD
// in x -- the opposite parity to everything here. It would be its own pair of
// knobs on the green channel, and it is not modelled.
//
//   INNER     x^2 is smooth and monotonic; a real profile is not, because the
//             set was converged at the centre AND checked at the edge, so what
//             is left over peaks somewhere in between -- which is why service
//             literature measures inner and outer trap error as separate
//             figures. sin^2(pi*|p.x|) is zero at both ends and 1 at half
//             width, so this adds a mid-width lobe worth convergence_inner
//             edge-offsets and leaves the edge calibration exactly where it
//             was. The profile stops being monotonic above 0.47 and the lobe
//             exceeds the edge value above 0.71. It shapes H_SIDES only.
//             Because that term depends on p.x alone, the profile is exactly
//             what you see scanning along ANY horizontal line -- unlike a
//             radial profile, whose interesting part hides inboard of the edge
//             and cost a test to discover.
//
// The two axes are SEPARATE knobs because they are not comparably visible when
// the NTSC stage is in the chain. Composite NTSC has already smeared the
// horizontal axis to about 330 TVL while leaving the 480-line vertical grid
// sharp, so horizontal fringing has almost nothing to fringe against and needs
// a much larger value to read at all. That asymmetry is real -- it is why
// vertical misconvergence is the one you notice on a real composite set too --
// so it is exposed rather than papered over. Start at h_sides 2, h_topbot 1,
// v_corner 0.4.
vec2 royale_convergence_bias(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 p = (royale_uv - 0.5) * 2.;
    float prof = p.x * p.x;
    if (convergence_inner != 0.) {
        float s = sin(3.14159265 * p.x);
        prof += convergence_inner * s * s;
    }
    return vec2(convergence_h_sides * prof + convergence_h_topbot * p.y * p.y,
                convergence_v_corner * p.x * p.y);
}

vec3 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_x_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_x_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).x;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec3 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_y_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_y_r, global.convergence_offset_y_g, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).y;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec2 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_r_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_y_r);
    return base + royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

vec2 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_g_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_y_g);
    // Green is the reference gun, so it carries no bias -- the
    // argument is here to keep the three call sites uniform.
    return base;
}

vec2 vertex_get_convergence_offsets_b_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_b, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    return base - royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

vec2 vertex_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset() {
    return vertex_aa_subpixel_r_offset_static;
}

float vertex_get_mask_amplify() {
    float mask_grille_amplify = 1. / vertex_mask_grille_avg_color;
    float mask_slot_amplify = 1. / vertex_mask_slot_avg_color;
    float mask_shadow_amplify = 1. / vertex_mask_shadow_avg_color;
    return global.mask_type < 0.5 ? mask_grille_amplify : global.mask_type < 1.5 ? mask_slot_amplify : mask_shadow_amplify;
}

float vertex_get_mask_sample_mode() {
    return global.mask_sample_mode_desired;
}

float vertex_ntsc_gamma = 2.2;
float vertex_pal_gamma = 2.8;
float vertex_crt_reference_gamma_high = 2.5;
float vertex_crt_reference_gamma_low = 2.35;
float vertex_lcd_reference_gamma = 2.5;
float vertex_crt_office_gamma = 2.2;
float vertex_lcd_office_gamma = 2.2;
bool vertex_assume_opaque_alpha = false;
float vertex_get_crt_gamma() {
    return global.crt_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_gba_gamma() {
    return vertex_gba_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_lcd_gamma() {
    return global.lcd_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_intermediate_gamma() {
    return vertex_ntsc_gamma;
}

float vertex_get_input_gamma() {
    return vertex_get_crt_gamma();
}

float vertex_get_output_gamma() {
    return vertex_get_lcd_gamma();
}

bool vertex_linearize_input = false;
float vertex_get_pass_input_gamma() {
    return 1.;
}

bool vertex_gamma_encode_output = true;
float vertex_get_pass_output_gamma() {
    return vertex_get_output_gamma();
}

bool vertex_gamma_aware_bilinear = !vertex_linearize_input;
vec4 vertex_encode_output(vec4 color) {
    if (vertex_gamma_encode_output) {
        if (vertex_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / vertex_get_pass_output_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / vertex_get_pass_output_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 vertex_decode_input(vec4 color) {
    if (vertex_linearize_input) {
        if (vertex_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(vertex_get_pass_input_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(vertex_get_pass_input_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 vertex_decode_gamma_input(vec4 color, vec3 gamma) {
    if (vertex_assume_opaque_alpha) {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, gamma), 1.);
    } else {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, gamma), color.a);
    }
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords) {
    return vertex_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords) {
    return vertex_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords.xy));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords, texel_off));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return vertex_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, vec3 gamma) {
    return vertex_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.), gamma);
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off, vec3 gamma) {
    return vertex_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off), gamma);
}

float vertex_aa_pixel_diameter = 1.;
float vertex_aa_lanczos_lobes = 3.;
float vertex_aa_gauss_support = 1. / vertex_aa_pixel_diameter;
float vertex_aa_tent_support = 1. / vertex_aa_pixel_diameter;
vec2 vertex_aa_xy_axis_importance = vertex_aa_filter < 5.5 ? vec2(1.) : vertex_aa_filter < 8.5 ? vec2(1., 0.) : vertex_aa_filter < 9.5 ? vec2(1., 1. / vertex_aa_lanczos_lobes) : vec2(1.);
float vertex_aa_box_support = 0.5;
float vertex_aa_cubic_support = 2.;
float vertex_aa_cubic_b;
float vertex_cubic_branch1_x3_coeff;
float vertex_cubic_branch1_x2_coeff;
float vertex_cubic_branch1_x0_coeff;
float vertex_cubic_branch2_x3_coeff;
float vertex_cubic_branch2_x2_coeff;
float vertex_cubic_branch2_x1_coeff;
float vertex_cubic_branch2_x0_coeff;
void vertex_assign_aa_cubic_constants() {
    if (vertex_aa_filter > 5.5 && vertex_aa_filter < 7.5) {
        vertex_aa_cubic_b = 1. - 2. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        vertex_cubic_branch1_x3_coeff = 12. - 9. * vertex_aa_cubic_b - 6. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        vertex_cubic_branch1_x2_coeff = -18. + 12. * vertex_aa_cubic_b + 6. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        vertex_cubic_branch1_x0_coeff = 6. - 2. * vertex_aa_cubic_b;
        vertex_cubic_branch2_x3_coeff = -vertex_aa_cubic_b - 6. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        vertex_cubic_branch2_x2_coeff = 6. * vertex_aa_cubic_b + 30. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        vertex_cubic_branch2_x1_coeff = -12. * vertex_aa_cubic_b - 48. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        vertex_cubic_branch2_x0_coeff = 8. * vertex_aa_cubic_b + 24. * global.aa_cubic_c;
    }
}

vec4 vertex_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance() {
    float base_support_radius = vertex_aa_filter < 1.5 ? vertex_aa_box_support : vertex_aa_filter < 3.5 ? vertex_aa_tent_support : vertex_aa_filter < 5.5 ? vertex_aa_gauss_support : vertex_aa_filter < 7.5 ? vertex_aa_cubic_support : vertex_aa_filter < 9.5 ? vertex_aa_lanczos_lobes : vertex_aa_box_support;
    vec2 subpixel_support_radius_raw = vec2(base_support_radius) + abs(vertex_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset());
    if (vertex_aa_filter < 1.5) {
        vec2 subpixel_support_diam = 2. * subpixel_support_radius_raw;
        vec2 final_axis_importance = vec2(1.);
        return vec4(subpixel_support_diam, final_axis_importance);
    } else {
        vec2 subpixel_support_radius = max(vec2(vertex_aa_box_support, vertex_aa_box_support), subpixel_support_radius_raw * vertex_aa_xy_axis_importance);
        vec2 final_axis_importance = vertex_aa_xy_axis_importance * subpixel_support_radius_raw / subpixel_support_radius;
        vec2 subpixel_support_diam = 2. * subpixel_support_radius;
        return vec4(subpixel_support_diam, final_axis_importance);
    }
}

float vertex_eval_box_filter(float dist) {
    return float(abs(dist) <= vertex_aa_box_support);
}

float vertex_eval_separable_box_filter(vec2 offset) {
    return float(all(bvec2(abs(offset.x) <= vertex_aa_box_support, abs(offset.y) <= vertex_aa_box_support)));
}

float vertex_eval_tent_filter(float dist) {
    return clamp((vertex_aa_tent_support - dist) / vertex_aa_tent_support, 0., 1.);
}

float vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(float dist) {
    return exp(-(dist * dist) / (2. * global.aa_gauss_sigma * global.aa_gauss_sigma));
}

float vertex_eval_cubic_filter(float dist) {
    float abs_dist = abs(dist);
    return (abs_dist < 1. ? (vertex_cubic_branch1_x3_coeff * abs_dist + vertex_cubic_branch1_x2_coeff) * abs_dist * abs_dist + vertex_cubic_branch1_x0_coeff : abs_dist < 2. ? ((vertex_cubic_branch2_x3_coeff * abs_dist + vertex_cubic_branch2_x2_coeff) * abs_dist + vertex_cubic_branch2_x1_coeff) * abs_dist + vertex_cubic_branch2_x0_coeff : 0.) / 6.;
}

float vertex_eval_separable_cubic_filter(vec2 offset) {
    return vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset.x) * vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset.y);
}

vec2 vertex_eval_sinc_filter(vec2 offset) {
    vec2 pi_offset = vertex_pi * offset;
    return sin(pi_offset) / pi_offset;
}

float vertex_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(vec2 offset_unsafe) {
    vec2 offset = max(abs(offset_unsafe), 0.000015258789);
    vec2 xy_weights = vertex_eval_sinc_filter(offset) * vertex_eval_sinc_filter(offset / vertex_aa_lanczos_lobes);
    return xy_weights.x * xy_weights.y;
}

float vertex_eval_jinc_filter_unorm(float x) {
    float point3845_x = 0.38448566 * x;
    float exp_term = exp(-(point3845_x * point3845_x));
    float point8154_plus_x = 0.81536233 + x;
    float cos_term = cos(point8154_plus_x);
    return 0.026472732 * min(x, 6.83135) + 0.68082356 * exp_term + -0.059725598 * min(7.410432, x) * cos_term / (point8154_plus_x + 0.06460746 * (x * x) + cos(x) * max(exp_term, cos(x) + cos_term)) - 0.1808375;
}

float vertex_eval_jinc_filter(float dist) {
    return vertex_eval_jinc_filter_unorm(vertex_pi * dist);
}

float vertex_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(float dist) {
    return vertex_eval_jinc_filter(dist) * vertex_eval_jinc_filter(dist / vertex_aa_lanczos_lobes);
}

vec3 vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(vec2 offset, vec2 final_axis_importance) {
    vec2 offset_g = offset * final_axis_importance;
    vec2 aa_r_offset = vertex_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset();
    vec2 offset_r = offset_g - aa_r_offset * final_axis_importance;
    vec2 offset_b = offset_g + aa_r_offset * final_axis_importance;
    if (vertex_aa_filter < 0.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_r), vertex_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_g), vertex_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_b));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 1.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_box_filter(length(offset_r)), vertex_eval_box_filter(length(offset_g)), vertex_eval_box_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 2.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_tent_filter(offset_r.x) * vertex_eval_tent_filter(offset_r.y), vertex_eval_tent_filter(offset_g.x) * vertex_eval_tent_filter(offset_g.y), vertex_eval_tent_filter(offset_b.x) * vertex_eval_tent_filter(offset_b.y));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 3.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_tent_filter(length(offset_r)), vertex_eval_tent_filter(length(offset_g)), vertex_eval_tent_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 4.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_r.x) * vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_r.y), vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_g.x) * vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_g.y), vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_b.x) * vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_b.y));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 5.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(length(offset_r)), vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(length(offset_g)), vertex_eval_gaussian_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 6.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset_r.x) * vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset_r.y), vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset_g.x) * vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset_g.y), vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset_b.x) * vertex_eval_cubic_filter(offset_b.y));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 7.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_cubic_filter(length(offset_r)), vertex_eval_cubic_filter(length(offset_g)), vertex_eval_cubic_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 8.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(offset_r), vertex_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(offset_g), vertex_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(offset_b));
    } else if (vertex_aa_filter < 9.5) {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(length(offset_r)), vertex_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(length(offset_g)), vertex_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else {
        return vec3(vertex_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_r), vertex_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_g), vertex_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_b));
    }
}

vec4 vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(sampler2D samp, vec2 s) {
    return vertex_tex2D_linearize(samp, s);
}

vec2 vertex_get_frame_sign(float frame) {
    if (vertex_aa_temporal) {
        float frame_odd = float(mod(frame, 2.) > 0.5);
        vec2 aa_r_offset = vertex_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset();
        vec2 mirror = -vec2(abs(aa_r_offset.x) < max(abs(0.), 0.000015258789), abs(aa_r_offset.y) < max(abs(0.), 0.000015258789));
        return mirror;
    } else {
        return vec2(1., 1.);
    }
}

vec3 vertex_tex2Daa_subpixel_weights_only(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv) {
    vec2 aa_r_offset = vertex_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset();
    vec2 aa_r_offset_uv_offset = aa_r_offset * pixel_to_tex_uv;
    float color_g = vertex_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).g;
    float color_r = vertex_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + aa_r_offset_uv_offset).r;
    float color_b = vertex_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - aa_r_offset_uv_offset).b;
    return vec3(color_r, color_g, color_b);
}

vec3 vertex_tex2Daa4x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 4.;
    vertex_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = vertex_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1., 1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5, 0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(0., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w3 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 half_sum = w0 + w1;
    vec3 w_sum = half_sum + half_sum.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1., 1., 1.) / w_sum;
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * vertex_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = vertex_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3);
}

vec3 vertex_tex2Daa5x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 5.;
    vertex_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = vertex_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(1., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(4., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset2 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 2.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset2, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w3 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w4 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / (w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4);
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * vertex_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = vertex_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;

    vec3 sample4 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset4).rgb;
    vec3 sample5 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset5).rgb;
    vec3 sample6 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset6).rgb;
    vec3 sample7 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset7).rgb;
    vec3 sample8 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset8).rgb;
    vec3 sample9 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset9).rgb;
    vec3 sample10 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset9).rgb;
    vec3 sample11 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset8).rgb;
    vec3 sample12 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset7).rgb;
    vec3 sample13 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset6).rgb;
    vec3 sample14 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset5).rgb;
    vec3 sample15 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset4).rgb;
    vec3 sample16 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset3).rgb;
    vec3 sample17 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample18 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample19 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3 + w4 * sample4 + w5 * sample5 + w6 * sample6 + w7 * sample7 + w8 * sample8 + w9 * sample9 + w10 * sample10 + w11 * sample11 + w12 * sample12 + w13 * sample13 + w14 * sample14 + w15 * sample15 + w16 * sample16 + w17 * sample17 + w18 * sample18 + w19 * sample19);
}

vec3 vertex_tex2Daa24x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 24.;
    vertex_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = vertex_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(6., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(16., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset2 = xy_start_offset + vec2(10., 2.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset3 = xy_start_offset + vec2(21., 3.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset4 = xy_start_offset + vec2(5., 4.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset5 = xy_start_offset + vec2(15., 5.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset6 = xy_start_offset + vec2(1., 6.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset7 = xy_start_offset + vec2(11., 7.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset8 = xy_start_offset + vec2(19., 8.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset9 = xy_start_offset + vec2(23., 9.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset10 = xy_start_offset + vec2(3., 10.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset11 = xy_start_offset + vec2(14., 11.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset2, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w3 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset3, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w4 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset4, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w5 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset5, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w6 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset6, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w7 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset7, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w8 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset8, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w9 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset9, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w10 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset10, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w11 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset11, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w12 = w11.bgr;
    vec3 w13 = w10.bgr;
    vec3 w14 = w9.bgr;
    vec3 w15 = w8.bgr;
    vec3 w16 = w7.bgr;
    vec3 w17 = w6.bgr;
    vec3 w18 = w5.bgr;
    vec3 w19 = w4.bgr;
    vec3 w20 = w3.bgr;
    vec3 w21 = w2.bgr;
    vec3 w22 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w23 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 half_sum = w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5 + w6 + w7 + w8 + w9 + w10 + w11;
    vec3 w_sum = half_sum + half_sum.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / w_sum;
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * vertex_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = vertex_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset2 = xy_offset2 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset3 = xy_offset3 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset4 = xy_offset4 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset5 = xy_offset5 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset6 = xy_offset6 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset7 = xy_offset7 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset8 = xy_offset8 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset9 = xy_offset9 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset10 = xy_offset10 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset11 = xy_offset11 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset3).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset4).rgb;
    vec3 sample5 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset5).rgb;
    vec3 sample6 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset6).rgb;
    vec3 sample7 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset7).rgb;
    vec3 sample8 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset8).rgb;
    vec3 sample9 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset9).rgb;
    vec3 sample10 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset10).rgb;
    vec3 sample11 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset11).rgb;
    vec3 sample12 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset11).rgb;
    vec3 sample13 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset10).rgb;
    vec3 sample14 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset9).rgb;
    vec3 sample15 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset8).rgb;
    vec3 sample16 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset7).rgb;
    vec3 sample17 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset6).rgb;
    vec3 sample18 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset5).rgb;
    vec3 sample19 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset4).rgb;
    vec3 sample20 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset3).rgb;
    vec3 sample21 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample22 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample23 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3 + w4 * sample4 + w5 * sample5 + w6 * sample6 + w7 * sample7 + w8 * sample8 + w9 * sample9 + w10 * sample10 + w11 * sample11 + w12 * sample12 + w13 * sample13 + w14 * sample14 + w15 * sample15 + w16 * sample16 + w17 * sample17 + w18 * sample18 + w19 * sample19 + w20 * sample20 + w21 * sample21 + w22 * sample22 + w23 * sample23);
}

vec3 vertex_tex2Daa_debug_16x_regular(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 4.;
    vertex_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = vertex_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(0., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(1., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset2 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset3 = xy_start_offset + vec2(3., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset4 = xy_start_offset + vec2(0., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset5 = xy_start_offset + vec2(1., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset6 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset7 = xy_start_offset + vec2(3., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset2, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w3 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset3, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w4 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset4, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w5 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset5, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w6 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset6, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w7 = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset7, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w8 = w7.bgr;
    vec3 w9 = w6.bgr;
    vec3 w10 = w5.bgr;
    vec3 w11 = w4.bgr;
    vec3 w12 = w3.bgr;
    vec3 w13 = w2.bgr;
    vec3 w14 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w15 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 half_sum = w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4 + w5 + w6 + w7;
    vec3 w_sum = half_sum + half_sum.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / w_sum;
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * vertex_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 uv_step_x = vec2(xy_step.x, 0.) * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_step_y = vec2(0., xy_step.y) * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset0 = -1.5 * (uv_step_x + uv_step_y);
    vec2 sample0_uv = tex_uv + uv_offset0;
    vec2 sample4_uv = sample0_uv + uv_step_y;
    vec2 sample8_uv = sample0_uv + uv_step_y * 2.;
    vec2 sample12_uv = sample0_uv + uv_step_y * 3.;
    vec3 sample0 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample0_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample0_uv + uv_step_x).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample0_uv + uv_step_x * 2.).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample0_uv + uv_step_x * 3.).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample4_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample5 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample4_uv + uv_step_x).rgb;
    vec3 sample6 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample4_uv + uv_step_x * 2.).rgb;
    vec3 sample7 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample4_uv + uv_step_x * 3.).rgb;
    vec3 sample8 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample8_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample9 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample8_uv + uv_step_x).rgb;
    vec3 sample10 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample8_uv + uv_step_x * 2.).rgb;
    vec3 sample11 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample8_uv + uv_step_x * 3.).rgb;
    vec3 sample12 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample12_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample13 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample12_uv + uv_step_x).rgb;
    vec3 sample14 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample12_uv + uv_step_x * 2.).rgb;
    vec3 sample15 = vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample12_uv + uv_step_x * 3.).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3 + w4 * sample4 + w5 * sample5 + w6 * sample6 + w7 * sample7 + w8 * sample8 + w9 * sample9 + w10 * sample10 + w11 * sample11 + w12 * sample12 + w13 * sample13 + w14 * sample14 + w15 * sample15);
}

vec3 vertex_tex2Daa_debug_dynamic(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    int grid_size = 8;
    vertex_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = vertex_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    float grid_radius_in_samples = (float(grid_size) - 1.) / 2.;
    vec2 filter_space_offset_step = subpixel_support_diameter / vec2(grid_size);
    vec2 sample0_filter_space_offset = -grid_radius_in_samples * filter_space_offset_step;
    vec3 weights[64];
    vec3 weight_sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
            vec2 offset = sample0_filter_space_offset + vec2(j, i) * filter_space_offset_step;
            vec3 weight = vertex_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(offset, final_axis_importance);
            weights[i * grid_size + j] = weight;
            weight_sum += weight;
        }
    }
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * vertex_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 uv_offset_step_x = vec2(filter_space_offset_step.x, 0.) * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset_step_y = vec2(0., filter_space_offset_step.y) * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 sample0_uv_offset = -grid_radius_in_samples * (uv_offset_step_x + uv_offset_step_y);
    vec2 sample0_uv = tex_uv + sample0_uv_offset;
    vec3 sum = vec3(0., 0., 0.);
    vec3 weight_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / weight_sum;
    for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
        vec2 row_i_first_sample_uv = sample0_uv + i * uv_offset_step_y;
        for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
            vec2 sample_uv = row_i_first_sample_uv + j * uv_offset_step_x;
            sum += weights[i * grid_size + j] * vertex_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, sample_uv).rgb;
        }
    }
    return sum * weight_sum_inv;
}

vec3 vertex_tex2Daa(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    return vertex_aa_level < 0.5 ? vertex_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb : vertex_aa_level < 3.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa_subpixel_weights_only(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv) : vertex_aa_level < 4.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa4x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 5.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa5x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 6.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa6x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 7.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa7x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 11.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa8x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 15.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa12x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 19.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa16x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 23.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa20x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 253.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa24x(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_aa_level < 254.5 ? vertex_tex2Daa_debug_16x_regular(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame) : vertex_tex2Daa_debug_dynamic(tex, tex_uv, pixel_to_tex_uv, frame);
}

vec2 vertex_quadratic_solve(float a, float b_over_2, float c) {
    float discriminant = b_over_2 * b_over_2 - a * c;
    float solution0 = c / (-b_over_2 + sqrt(discriminant));
    return vec2(solution0, discriminant);
}

vec2 vertex_intersect_sphere(vec3 view_vec, vec3 eye_pos_vec) {
    float a = dot(view_vec, view_vec);
    float b_over_2 = dot(view_vec, eye_pos_vec);
    float c = dot(eye_pos_vec, eye_pos_vec) - global.geom_radius * global.geom_radius;
    return vertex_quadratic_solve(a, b_over_2, c);
}

vec2 vertex_intersect_cylinder(vec3 view_vec, vec3 eye_pos_vec) {
    vec3 cylinder_top_vec = vec3(0., global.geom_radius, 0.);
    vec3 cylinder_axis_vec = vec3(0., 1., 0.);
    vec3 top_to_eye_vec = eye_pos_vec - cylinder_top_vec;
    vec3 axis_x_view = cross(cylinder_axis_vec, view_vec);
    vec3 axis_x_top_to_eye = cross(cylinder_axis_vec, top_to_eye_vec);
    float a = dot(axis_x_view, axis_x_view);
    float b_over_2 = dot(axis_x_top_to_eye, axis_x_view);
    float c = dot(axis_x_top_to_eye, axis_x_top_to_eye) - global.geom_radius * global.geom_radius;
    return vertex_quadratic_solve(a, b_over_2, c);
}

vec2 vertex_cylinder_xyz_to_uv(vec3 intersection_pos_local, vec2 geom_aspect) {
    float angle_from_image_center = atan(intersection_pos_local.x, intersection_pos_local.z);
    float signed_arc_len = angle_from_image_center * global.geom_radius;
    vec2 square_uv = vec2(signed_arc_len, -intersection_pos_local.y);
    vec2 video_uv = square_uv / geom_aspect;
    return video_uv;
}

vec3 vertex_cylinder_uv_to_xyz(vec2 video_uv, vec2 geom_aspect) {
    vec2 square_uv = video_uv * geom_aspect;
    float arc_len = square_uv.x;
    float angle_from_image_center = arc_len / global.geom_radius;
    float x_pos = sin(angle_from_image_center) * global.geom_radius;
    float z_pos = cos(angle_from_image_center) * global.geom_radius;
    vec3 intersection_pos_local = vec3(x_pos, -square_uv.y, z_pos);
    return intersection_pos_local;
}

vec2 vertex_sphere_xyz_to_uv(vec3 intersection_pos_local, vec2 geom_aspect) {
    vec3 image_center_pos_local = vec3(0., 0., global.geom_radius);
    float cp_len = length(cross(intersection_pos_local, image_center_pos_local));
    float dp = dot(intersection_pos_local, image_center_pos_local);
    float angle_from_image_center = atan(cp_len, dp);
    float arc_len = angle_from_image_center * global.geom_radius;
    vec2 square_uv_unit = normalize(vec2(intersection_pos_local.x, -intersection_pos_local.y));
    vec2 square_uv = arc_len * square_uv_unit;
    vec2 video_uv = square_uv / geom_aspect;
    return video_uv;
}

vec3 vertex_sphere_uv_to_xyz(vec2 video_uv, vec2 geom_aspect) {
    vec2 square_uv = video_uv * geom_aspect;
    vec2 square_uv_unit = normalize(square_uv);
    float arc_len = square_uv.y / square_uv_unit.y;
    float angle_from_image_center = arc_len / global.geom_radius;
    float xy_dist_from_sphere_center = sin(angle_from_image_center) * global.geom_radius;
    vec2 xy_pos = xy_dist_from_sphere_center * square_uv_unit;
    float z_pos = cos(angle_from_image_center) * global.geom_radius;
    vec3 intersection_pos_local = vec3(xy_pos.x, -xy_pos.y, z_pos);
    return intersection_pos_local;
}

vec2 vertex_sphere_alt_xyz_to_uv(vec3 intersection_pos_local, vec2 geom_aspect) {
    vec2 angle_from_image_center = atan(vec2(intersection_pos_local.x, -intersection_pos_local.y), intersection_pos_local.zz);
    vec2 signed_arc_len = angle_from_image_center * global.geom_radius;
    vec2 video_uv = signed_arc_len / geom_aspect;
    return video_uv;
}

vec3 vertex_sphere_alt_uv_to_xyz(vec2 video_uv, vec2 geom_aspect) {
    vec2 square_uv = video_uv * geom_aspect;
    vec2 arc_len = square_uv;
    vec2 angle_from_image_center = arc_len / global.geom_radius;
    vec2 xy_pos = sin(angle_from_image_center) * global.geom_radius;
    float z_pos = sqrt(global.geom_radius * global.geom_radius - dot(xy_pos, xy_pos));
    return vec3(xy_pos.x, -xy_pos.y, z_pos);
}

vec2 vertex_intersect(vec3 view_vec_local, vec3 eye_pos_local, float geom_mode) {
    return geom_mode < 2.5 ? vertex_intersect_sphere(view_vec_local, eye_pos_local) : vertex_intersect_cylinder(view_vec_local, eye_pos_local);
}

vec2 vertex_xyz_to_uv(vec3 intersection_pos_local, vec2 geom_aspect, float geom_mode) {
    return geom_mode < 1.5 ? vertex_sphere_xyz_to_uv(intersection_pos_local, geom_aspect) : geom_mode < 2.5 ? vertex_sphere_alt_xyz_to_uv(intersection_pos_local, geom_aspect) : vertex_cylinder_xyz_to_uv(intersection_pos_local, geom_aspect);
}

vec3 vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2 uv, vec2 geom_aspect, float geom_mode) {
    return geom_mode < 1.5 ? vertex_sphere_uv_to_xyz(uv, geom_aspect) : geom_mode < 2.5 ? vertex_sphere_alt_uv_to_xyz(uv, geom_aspect) : vertex_cylinder_uv_to_xyz(uv, geom_aspect);
}

vec2 vertex_view_vec_to_uv(vec3 view_vec_local, vec3 eye_pos_local, vec2 geom_aspect, float geom_mode, out vec3 intersection_pos) {
    vec2 intersect_dist_and_discriminant = vertex_intersect(view_vec_local, eye_pos_local, geom_mode);
    vec3 intersection_pos_local = eye_pos_local + view_vec_local * intersect_dist_and_discriminant.x;
    intersection_pos = intersection_pos_local;
    return intersect_dist_and_discriminant.y > 0.005 ? vertex_xyz_to_uv(intersection_pos_local, geom_aspect, geom_mode) : vec2(1.);
}

vec3 vertex_get_ideal_global_eye_pos_for_points(vec3 eye_pos, vec2 geom_aspect, vec3 global_coords[9], int num_points) {
    int max_centering_iters = 1;
    for (int iter = 0; iter < max_centering_iters; iter++) {
        vec3 eyespace_coords[9];
        for (int i = 0; i < num_points; i++) {
            eyespace_coords[i] = global_coords[i] - eye_pos;
        }
        float abs_radius = abs(global.geom_radius);
        vec2 offset_dr_min = vec2(10. * abs_radius, 10. * abs_radius);
        vec2 offset_ul_max = vec2(-10. * abs_radius, -10. * abs_radius);
        for (int i = 0; i < num_points; i++) {
            vec2 flipy = vec2(1., -1.);
            vec3 eyespace_xyz = eyespace_coords[i];
            vec2 offset_dr = eyespace_xyz.xy - vec2(-0.5) * (geom_aspect * -eyespace_xyz.z) / (global.geom_view_dist * flipy);
            vec2 offset_ul = eyespace_xyz.xy - vec2(0.5) * (geom_aspect * -eyespace_xyz.z) / (global.geom_view_dist * flipy);
            offset_dr_min = min(offset_dr_min, offset_dr);
            offset_ul_max = max(offset_ul_max, offset_ul);
        }
        vec2 center_offset = 0.5 * (offset_ul_max + offset_dr_min);
        eye_pos.xy += center_offset;
        for (int i = 0; i < num_points; i++) {
            eyespace_coords[i] = global_coords[i] - eye_pos;
        }
        float offset_z_max = -10. * global.geom_radius * global.geom_view_dist;
        for (int i = 0; i < num_points; i++) {
            vec3 eyespace_xyz_flipy = eyespace_coords[i] * vec3(1., -1., 1.);
            vec4 offset_zzzz = eyespace_xyz_flipy.zzzz + eyespace_xyz_flipy.xyxy * global.geom_view_dist / (vec4(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5) * vec4(geom_aspect, geom_aspect));
            offset_z_max = eyespace_xyz_flipy.x < 0. ? max(offset_z_max, offset_zzzz.x) : offset_z_max;
            offset_z_max = eyespace_xyz_flipy.y < 0. ? max(offset_z_max, offset_zzzz.y) : offset_z_max;
            offset_z_max = eyespace_xyz_flipy.x > 0. ? max(offset_z_max, offset_zzzz.z) : offset_z_max;
            offset_z_max = eyespace_xyz_flipy.y > 0. ? max(offset_z_max, offset_zzzz.w) : offset_z_max;
            offset_z_max = max(offset_z_max, eyespace_xyz_flipy.z);
        }
        eye_pos.z += offset_z_max;
    }
    return eye_pos;
}

vec3 vertex_get_ideal_global_eye_pos(mat3x3 local_to_global, vec2 geom_aspect, float geom_mode) {
    vec3 high_view = vec3(0., geom_aspect.y, -global.geom_view_dist);
    vec3 low_view = high_view * vec3(1., -1., 1.);
    float len_sq = dot(high_view, high_view);
    float fov = abs(acos(dot(high_view, low_view) / len_sq));
    float eye_z_spherical = global.geom_radius / sin(fov * 0.5);
    vec3 eye_pos = geom_mode < 2.5 ? vec3(0., 0., eye_z_spherical) : vec3(0., 0., max(global.geom_view_dist, eye_z_spherical));
    int num_points = 9;
    vec3 global_coords[9];
    global_coords[0] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(0., 0.), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[1] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(0., -0.5), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[2] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(0., 0.5), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[3] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(-0.5, 0.), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[4] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(0.5, 0.), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[5] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(-0.5, -0.5), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[6] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(0.5, -0.5), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[7] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(-0.5, 0.5), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    global_coords[8] = vertex_uv_to_xyz(vec2(0.5, 0.5), geom_aspect, geom_mode) * local_to_global;
    float num_negative_z_coords = 0.;
    for (int i = 0; i < num_points; i++) {
        num_negative_z_coords += float(global_coords[0].z < 0.);
    }
    return num_negative_z_coords > 0.5 ? eye_pos : vertex_get_ideal_global_eye_pos_for_points(eye_pos, geom_aspect, global_coords, num_points);
}

mat3x3 vertex_get_pixel_to_object_matrix(mat3x3 global_to_local, vec3 eye_pos_local, vec3 view_vec_global, vec3 intersection_pos_local, vec3 normal, vec2 output_size_inv) {
    vec3 pos = intersection_pos_local;
    vec3 eye_pos = eye_pos_local;
    vec3 view_vec_right_global = view_vec_global + vec3(output_size_inv.x, 0., 0.);
    vec3 view_vec_down_global = view_vec_global + vec3(0., -output_size_inv.y, 0.);
    vec3 view_vec_right_local = view_vec_right_global * global_to_local;
    vec3 view_vec_down_local = view_vec_down_global * global_to_local;
    vec3 intersection_vec_dot_normal = vec3(dot(pos - eye_pos, normal), dot(pos - eye_pos, normal), dot(pos - eye_pos, normal));
    vec3 right_pos = eye_pos + intersection_vec_dot_normal / dot(view_vec_right_local, normal) * view_vec_right_local;
    vec3 down_pos = eye_pos + intersection_vec_dot_normal / dot(view_vec_down_local, normal) * view_vec_down_local;
    vec3 object_right_vec = right_pos - pos;
    vec3 object_down_vec = down_pos - pos;
    mat3x3 pixel_to_object = mat3x3(object_right_vec.x, object_down_vec.x, 0., object_right_vec.y, object_down_vec.y, 0., object_right_vec.z, object_down_vec.z, 0.);
    return pixel_to_object;
}

mat3x3 vertex_get_object_to_tangent_matrix(vec3 intersection_pos_local, vec3 normal, vec2 geom_aspect, float geom_mode) {
    vec3 pos = intersection_pos_local;
    vec3 x_vec = vec3(1., 0., 0.);
    vec3 y_vec = vec3(0., 1., 0.);
    vec3 cotangent_unscaled, cobitangent_unscaled;
    if (geom_mode < 1.5) {
        cotangent_unscaled = normalize(cross(y_vec, pos)) * geom_aspect.y;
        cobitangent_unscaled = normalize(cross(x_vec, pos)) * geom_aspect.x;
    } else if (geom_mode < 2.5) {
        vec3 tangent = normalize(cross(y_vec, vec3(pos.x, 0., pos.z))) * geom_aspect.x;
        vec3 bitangent = normalize(cross(x_vec, vec3(0., pos.yz))) * geom_aspect.y;
        cotangent_unscaled = cross(normal, bitangent);
        cobitangent_unscaled = cross(tangent, normal);
    } else {
        cotangent_unscaled = cross(y_vec, normal) * geom_aspect.y;
        cobitangent_unscaled = vec3(0., -geom_aspect.x, 0.);
    }
    vec3 computed_normal = cross(cobitangent_unscaled, cotangent_unscaled);
    float inv_determinant = inversesqrt(dot(computed_normal, computed_normal));
    vec3 cotangent = cotangent_unscaled * inv_determinant;
    vec3 cobitangent = cobitangent_unscaled * inv_determinant;
    mat3x3 object_to_tangent = mat3x3(cotangent, cobitangent, normal);
    return object_to_tangent;
}

vec2 vertex_get_curved_video_uv_coords_and_tangent_matrix(vec2 flat_video_uv, vec3 eye_pos_local, vec2 output_size_inv, vec2 geom_aspect, float geom_mode, mat3x3 global_to_local, out mat2x2 pixel_to_tangent_video_uv) {
    vec2 view_uv = (flat_video_uv - vec2(0.5)) * geom_aspect;
    vec3 view_vec_global = vec3(view_uv.x, -view_uv.y, -global.geom_view_dist);
    vec3 view_vec_local = view_vec_global * global_to_local;
    vec3 pos;
    vec2 centered_uv = vertex_view_vec_to_uv(view_vec_local, eye_pos_local, geom_aspect, geom_mode, pos);
    vec2 video_uv = centered_uv + vec2(0.5);
    if (vertex_geom_force_correct_tangent_matrix) {
        vec3 normal_base = geom_mode < 2.5 ? pos : vec3(pos.x, 0., pos.z);
        vec3 normal = normalize(normal_base);
        mat3x3 pixel_to_object = vertex_get_pixel_to_object_matrix(global_to_local, eye_pos_local, view_vec_global, pos, normal, output_size_inv);
        mat3x3 object_to_tangent = vertex_get_object_to_tangent_matrix(pos, normal, geom_aspect, geom_mode);
        mat3x3 pixel_to_tangent3x3 = pixel_to_object * object_to_tangent;
        pixel_to_tangent_video_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tangent3x3[0][0], pixel_to_tangent3x3[0][1], pixel_to_tangent3x3[1][0], pixel_to_tangent3x3[1][1]);
    } else {
        pixel_to_tangent_video_uv = mat2x2(output_size_inv.x, 0., 0., output_size_inv.y);
    }
    return video_uv;
}

float vertex_get_border_dim_factor(vec2 video_uv, vec2 geom_aspect) {
    vec2 edge_dists = min(video_uv, vec2(1.) - video_uv) * geom_aspect;
    vec2 border_penetration = max(vec2(global.border_size) - edge_dists, vec2(0.));
    float penetration_ratio = length(border_penetration) / global.border_size;
    if (global.border_size == 0.) penetration_ratio = 0.;
    float border_escape_ratio = max(1. - penetration_ratio, 0.);
    float border_dim_factor = pow(border_escape_ratio, global.border_darkness) * max(1., global.border_compress);
    return min(border_dim_factor, 1.);
}

mat2x2 vertex_mul_scale(vec2 scale, mat2x2 matrix) {
    vec4 temp_matrix = vec4(matrix[0][0], matrix[0][1], matrix[1][0], matrix[1][1]) * scale.xxyy;
    return mat2x2(temp_matrix.x, temp_matrix.y, temp_matrix.z, temp_matrix.w);
}

vec4 Position = vec4(HOOKED_pos, 0., 1.);
vec2 TexCoord = HOOKED_pos;
vec2 tex_uv;
vec4 video_and_texture_size_inv;
vec2 output_size_inv;
vec3 eye_pos_local;
vec4 geom_aspect_and_overscan;
vec3 global_to_local_row0;
vec3 global_to_local_row1;
vec3 global_to_local_row2;
void vertex_main() {
    vertex_gl_Position = global.MVP * Position;
    tex_uv = TexCoord;
    video_and_texture_size_inv = vec4(1., 1., 1., 1.) / vec4(params.SourceSize.xy, params.SourceSize.xy);
    output_size_inv = vec2(1., 1.) / params.OutputSize.xy;
    float viewport_aspect_ratio = params.OutputSize.xy.x / params.OutputSize.xy.y;
    vec2 geom_aspect = vertex_get_aspect_vector(viewport_aspect_ratio);
    vec2 geom_overscan = vertex_get_geom_overscan_vector();
    geom_aspect_and_overscan = vec4(geom_aspect, geom_overscan);
    vec2 geom_tilt_angle = vertex_get_geom_tilt_angle_vector();
    vec2 sin_tilt = sin(geom_tilt_angle);
    vec2 cos_tilt = cos(geom_tilt_angle);
    mat3x3 rot_x_matrix = mat3x3(1., 0., 0., 0., cos_tilt.y, -sin_tilt.y, 0., sin_tilt.y, cos_tilt.y);
    mat3x3 rot_y_matrix = mat3x3(cos_tilt.x, 0., sin_tilt.x, 0., 1., 0., -sin_tilt.x, 0., cos_tilt.x);
    mat3x3 local_to_global = rot_x_matrix * rot_y_matrix;
    mat3x3 global_to_local = transpose(local_to_global);
    global_to_local_row0 = vec3(global_to_local[0][0], global_to_local[0][1], global_to_local[0][2]);
    global_to_local_row1 = vec3(global_to_local[1][0], global_to_local[1][1], global_to_local[1][2]);
    global_to_local_row2 = vec3(global_to_local[2][0], global_to_local[2][1], global_to_local[2][2]);
    float geom_mode = global.geom_mode_runtime;
    vec3 eye_pos_global = vertex_get_ideal_global_eye_pos(local_to_global, geom_aspect, geom_mode);
    eye_pos_local = eye_pos_global * global_to_local;
}

vec2 fragment_get_aspect_vector(float geom_aspect_ratio) {
    float geom_clamped_aspect_ratio = min(geom_aspect_ratio, fragment_geom_max_aspect_ratio);
    vec2 geom_aspect = normalize(vec2(geom_clamped_aspect_ratio, 1.));
    return geom_aspect;
}

vec2 fragment_get_geom_overscan_vector() {
    return vec2(global.geom_overscan_x, global.geom_overscan_y);
}

vec2 fragment_get_geom_tilt_angle_vector() {
    return vec2(global.geom_tilt_angle_x, global.geom_tilt_angle_y);
}

vec3 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_x_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_x_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).x;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec3 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_y_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec3 base = vec3(global.convergence_offset_y_r, global.convergence_offset_y_g, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    float bias = royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv).y;
    return base + vec3(bias, 0., -bias);
}

vec2 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_r_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_r, global.convergence_offset_y_r);
    return base + royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

vec2 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_g_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_g, global.convergence_offset_y_g);
    // Green is the reference gun, so it carries no bias -- the
    // argument is here to keep the three call sites uniform.
    return base;
}

vec2 fragment_get_convergence_offsets_b_vector(vec2 royale_uv) {
    vec2 base = vec2(global.convergence_offset_x_b, global.convergence_offset_y_b);
    return base - royale_convergence_bias(royale_uv);
}

vec2 fragment_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset() {
    return fragment_aa_subpixel_r_offset_static;
}

float fragment_get_mask_amplify() {
    float mask_grille_amplify = 1. / fragment_mask_grille_avg_color;
    float mask_slot_amplify = 1. / fragment_mask_slot_avg_color;
    float mask_shadow_amplify = 1. / fragment_mask_shadow_avg_color;
    return global.mask_type < 0.5 ? mask_grille_amplify : global.mask_type < 1.5 ? mask_slot_amplify : mask_shadow_amplify;
}

float fragment_get_mask_sample_mode() {
    return global.mask_sample_mode_desired;
}

float fragment_ntsc_gamma = 2.2;
float fragment_pal_gamma = 2.8;

float fragment_crt_reference_gamma_low = 2.35;
float fragment_lcd_reference_gamma = 2.5;
float fragment_crt_office_gamma = 2.2;
float fragment_lcd_office_gamma = 2.2;
bool fragment_assume_opaque_alpha = false;
float fragment_get_crt_gamma() {
    return global.crt_gamma;
}

float fragment_get_gba_gamma() {
    return fragment_gba_gamma;
}

    return global.lcd_gamma;
}

    return fragment_ntsc_gamma;
}

float fragment_get_input_gamma() {
    return fragment_get_crt_gamma();
}

float fragment_get_output_gamma() {
    return fragment_get_lcd_gamma();
}

bool fragment_linearize_input = false;
float fragment_get_pass_input_gamma() {
    return 1.;
}

bool fragment_gamma_encode_output = true;
float fragment_get_pass_output_gamma() {
    return fragment_get_output_gamma();
}

bool fragment_gamma_aware_bilinear = !fragment_linearize_input;
vec4 fragment_encode_output(vec4 color) {
    if (fragment_gamma_encode_output) {
        if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / fragment_get_pass_output_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(1. / fragment_get_pass_output_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 fragment_decode_input(vec4 color) {
    if (fragment_linearize_input) {
        if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(fragment_get_pass_input_gamma())), 1.);
        } else {
            return vec4(pow(color.rgb, vec3(fragment_get_pass_input_gamma())), color.a);
        }
    } else {
        return color;
    }
}

vec4 fragment_decode_gamma_input(vec4 color, vec3 gamma) {
    if (fragment_assume_opaque_alpha) {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, gamma), 1.);
    } else {
        return vec4(pow(color.rgb, gamma), color.a);
    }
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords) {
    return fragment_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords) {
    return fragment_decode_input(texture(tex, tex_coords.xy));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords, texel_off));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2D_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec3 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off) {
    return fragment_decode_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off));
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, vec3 gamma) {
    return fragment_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, 0.), gamma);
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Dlod_linearize_gamma(sampler2D tex, vec4 tex_coords, int texel_off, vec3 gamma) {
    return fragment_decode_gamma_input(textureLod(tex, tex_coords.xy, texel_off), gamma);
}

float fragment_aa_pixel_diameter = 1.;
float fragment_aa_lanczos_lobes = 3.;
float fragment_aa_gauss_support = 1. / fragment_aa_pixel_diameter;
float fragment_aa_tent_support = 1. / fragment_aa_pixel_diameter;
vec2 fragment_aa_xy_axis_importance = fragment_aa_filter < 5.5 ? vec2(1.) : fragment_aa_filter < 8.5 ? vec2(1., 0.) : fragment_aa_filter < 9.5 ? vec2(1., 1. / fragment_aa_lanczos_lobes) : vec2(1.);
float fragment_aa_box_support = 0.5;
float fragment_aa_cubic_support = 2.;
float fragment_aa_cubic_b;
float fragment_cubic_branch1_x3_coeff;
float fragment_cubic_branch1_x2_coeff;
float fragment_cubic_branch1_x0_coeff;
float fragment_cubic_branch2_x3_coeff;
float fragment_cubic_branch2_x2_coeff;
float fragment_cubic_branch2_x1_coeff;
float fragment_cubic_branch2_x0_coeff;
void fragment_assign_aa_cubic_constants() {
    if (fragment_aa_filter > 5.5 && fragment_aa_filter < 7.5) {
        fragment_aa_cubic_b = 1. - 2. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        fragment_cubic_branch1_x3_coeff = 12. - 9. * fragment_aa_cubic_b - 6. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        fragment_cubic_branch1_x2_coeff = -18. + 12. * fragment_aa_cubic_b + 6. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        fragment_cubic_branch1_x0_coeff = 6. - 2. * fragment_aa_cubic_b;
        fragment_cubic_branch2_x3_coeff = -fragment_aa_cubic_b - 6. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        fragment_cubic_branch2_x2_coeff = 6. * fragment_aa_cubic_b + 30. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        fragment_cubic_branch2_x1_coeff = -12. * fragment_aa_cubic_b - 48. * global.aa_cubic_c;
        fragment_cubic_branch2_x0_coeff = 8. * fragment_aa_cubic_b + 24. * global.aa_cubic_c;
    }
}

vec4 fragment_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance() {
    float base_support_radius = fragment_aa_filter < 1.5 ? fragment_aa_box_support : fragment_aa_filter < 3.5 ? fragment_aa_tent_support : fragment_aa_filter < 5.5 ? fragment_aa_gauss_support : fragment_aa_filter < 7.5 ? fragment_aa_cubic_support : fragment_aa_filter < 9.5 ? fragment_aa_lanczos_lobes : fragment_aa_box_support;
    vec2 subpixel_support_radius_raw = vec2(base_support_radius) + abs(fragment_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset());
    if (fragment_aa_filter < 1.5) {
        vec2 subpixel_support_diam = 2. * subpixel_support_radius_raw;
        vec2 final_axis_importance = vec2(1.);
        return vec4(subpixel_support_diam, final_axis_importance);
    } else {
        vec2 subpixel_support_radius = max(vec2(fragment_aa_box_support, fragment_aa_box_support), subpixel_support_radius_raw * fragment_aa_xy_axis_importance);
        vec2 final_axis_importance = fragment_aa_xy_axis_importance * subpixel_support_radius_raw / subpixel_support_radius;
        vec2 subpixel_support_diam = 2. * subpixel_support_radius;
        return vec4(subpixel_support_diam, final_axis_importance);
    }
}

float fragment_eval_box_filter(float dist) {
    return float(abs(dist) <= fragment_aa_box_support);
}

float fragment_eval_separable_box_filter(vec2 offset) {
    return float(all(bvec2(abs(offset.x) <= fragment_aa_box_support, abs(offset.y) <= fragment_aa_box_support)));
}

float fragment_eval_tent_filter(float dist) {
    return clamp((fragment_aa_tent_support - dist) / fragment_aa_tent_support, 0., 1.);
}

float fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(float dist) {
    return exp(-(dist * dist) / (2. * global.aa_gauss_sigma * global.aa_gauss_sigma));
}

float fragment_eval_cubic_filter(float dist) {
    float abs_dist = abs(dist);
    return (abs_dist < 1. ? (fragment_cubic_branch1_x3_coeff * abs_dist + fragment_cubic_branch1_x2_coeff) * abs_dist * abs_dist + fragment_cubic_branch1_x0_coeff : abs_dist < 2. ? ((fragment_cubic_branch2_x3_coeff * abs_dist + fragment_cubic_branch2_x2_coeff) * abs_dist + fragment_cubic_branch2_x1_coeff) * abs_dist + fragment_cubic_branch2_x0_coeff : 0.) / 6.;
}

float fragment_eval_separable_cubic_filter(vec2 offset) {
    return fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset.x) * fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset.y);
}

vec2 fragment_eval_sinc_filter(vec2 offset) {
    vec2 pi_offset = fragment_pi * offset;
    return sin(pi_offset) / pi_offset;
}

float fragment_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(vec2 offset_unsafe) {
    vec2 offset = max(abs(offset_unsafe), 0.000015258789);
    vec2 xy_weights = fragment_eval_sinc_filter(offset) * fragment_eval_sinc_filter(offset / fragment_aa_lanczos_lobes);
    return xy_weights.x * xy_weights.y;
}

float fragment_eval_jinc_filter_unorm(float x) {
    float point3845_x = 0.38448566 * x;
    float exp_term = exp(-(point3845_x * point3845_x));
    float point8154_plus_x = 0.81536233 + x;
    float cos_term = cos(point8154_plus_x);
    return 0.026472732 * min(x, 6.83135) + 0.68082356 * exp_term + -0.059725598 * min(7.410432, x) * cos_term / (point8154_plus_x + 0.06460746 * (x * x) + cos(x) * max(exp_term, cos(x) + cos_term)) - 0.1808375;
}

float fragment_eval_jinc_filter(float dist) {
    return fragment_eval_jinc_filter_unorm(fragment_pi * dist);
}

float fragment_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(float dist) {
    return fragment_eval_jinc_filter(dist) * fragment_eval_jinc_filter(dist / fragment_aa_lanczos_lobes);
}

vec3 fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(vec2 offset, vec2 final_axis_importance) {
    vec2 offset_g = offset * final_axis_importance;
    vec2 aa_r_offset = fragment_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset();
    vec2 offset_r = offset_g - aa_r_offset * final_axis_importance;
    vec2 offset_b = offset_g + aa_r_offset * final_axis_importance;
    if (fragment_aa_filter < 0.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_r), fragment_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_g), fragment_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_b));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 1.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_box_filter(length(offset_r)), fragment_eval_box_filter(length(offset_g)), fragment_eval_box_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 2.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_tent_filter(offset_r.x) * fragment_eval_tent_filter(offset_r.y), fragment_eval_tent_filter(offset_g.x) * fragment_eval_tent_filter(offset_g.y), fragment_eval_tent_filter(offset_b.x) * fragment_eval_tent_filter(offset_b.y));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 3.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_tent_filter(length(offset_r)), fragment_eval_tent_filter(length(offset_g)), fragment_eval_tent_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 4.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_r.x) * fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_r.y), fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_g.x) * fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_g.y), fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_b.x) * fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(offset_b.y));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 5.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(length(offset_r)), fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(length(offset_g)), fragment_eval_gaussian_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 6.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset_r.x) * fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset_r.y), fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset_g.x) * fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset_g.y), fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset_b.x) * fragment_eval_cubic_filter(offset_b.y));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 7.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_cubic_filter(length(offset_r)), fragment_eval_cubic_filter(length(offset_g)), fragment_eval_cubic_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 8.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(offset_r), fragment_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(offset_g), fragment_eval_separable_lanczos_sinc_filter(offset_b));
    } else if (fragment_aa_filter < 9.5) {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(length(offset_r)), fragment_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(length(offset_g)), fragment_eval_lanczos_jinc_filter(length(offset_b)));
    } else {
        return vec3(fragment_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_r), fragment_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_g), fragment_eval_separable_box_filter(offset_b));
    }
}

vec4 fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(sampler2D samp, vec2 s) {
    return fragment_tex2D_linearize(samp, s);
}

vec2 fragment_get_frame_sign(float frame) {
    if (fragment_aa_temporal) {
        float frame_odd = float(mod(frame, 2.) > 0.5);
        vec2 aa_r_offset = fragment_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset();
        vec2 mirror = -vec2(abs(aa_r_offset.x) < max(abs(0.), 0.000015258789), abs(aa_r_offset.y) < max(abs(0.), 0.000015258789));
        return mirror;
    } else {
        return vec2(1., 1.);
    }
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Daa_subpixel_weights_only(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv) {
    vec2 aa_r_offset = fragment_get_aa_subpixel_r_offset();
    vec2 aa_r_offset_uv_offset = aa_r_offset * pixel_to_tex_uv;
    float color_g = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv).g;
    float color_r = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv + aa_r_offset_uv_offset).r;
    float color_b = fragment_tex2D_linearize(tex, tex_uv - aa_r_offset_uv_offset).b;
    return vec3(color_r, color_g, color_b);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Daa4x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 4.;
    fragment_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = fragment_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1., 1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5, 0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(0., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w3 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 half_sum = w0 + w1;
    vec3 w_sum = half_sum + half_sum.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1., 1., 1.) / w_sum;
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * fragment_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = fragment_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Daa5x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 5.;
    fragment_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = fragment_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(1., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(4., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset2 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 2.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset2, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w3 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w4 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / (w0 + w1 + w2 + w3 + w4);
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * fragment_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = fragment_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3 + w4 * sample4);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Daa6x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 6.;
    fragment_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = fragment_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(4., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset2 = xy_start_offset + vec2(0., 2.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset2, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w3 = w2.bgr;
    vec3 w4 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w5 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 half_sum = w0 + w1 + w2;
    vec3 w_sum = half_sum + half_sum.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / w_sum;
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * fragment_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = fragment_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset2 = xy_offset2 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample5 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3 + w4 * sample4 + w5 * sample5);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Daa7x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 7.;
    fragment_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = fragment_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(1., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(4., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset2 = xy_start_offset + vec2(0., 2.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset3 = xy_start_offset + vec2(3., 3.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset2, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w3 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset3, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w4 = w2.bgr;
    vec3 w5 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w6 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 half_sum = w0 + w1 + w2;
    vec3 w_sum = half_sum + half_sum.bgr + w3;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / w_sum;
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * fragment_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = fragment_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset2 = xy_offset2 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample5 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample6 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
    return w_sum_inv * (w0 * sample0 + w1 * sample1 + w2 * sample2 + w3 * sample3 + w4 * sample4 + w5 * sample5 + w6 * sample6);
}

vec3 fragment_tex2Daa8x(sampler2D tex, vec2 tex_uv, mat2x2 pixel_to_tex_uv, float frame) {
    float grid_size = 8.;
    fragment_assign_aa_cubic_constants();
    vec4 ssd_fai = fragment_get_subpixel_support_diam_and_final_axis_importance();
    vec2 subpixel_support_diameter = ssd_fai.xy;
    vec2 final_axis_importance = ssd_fai.zw;
    vec2 xy_step = vec2(1.) / grid_size * subpixel_support_diameter;
    vec2 xy_start_offset = vec2(0.5 - grid_size * 0.5) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset0 = xy_start_offset + vec2(2., 0.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset1 = xy_start_offset + vec2(4., 1.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset2 = xy_start_offset + vec2(1., 2.) * xy_step;
    vec2 xy_offset3 = xy_start_offset + vec2(7., 3.) * xy_step;
    vec3 w0 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset0, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w1 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset1, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w2 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset2, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w3 = fragment_eval_unorm_rgb_weights(xy_offset3, final_axis_importance);
    vec3 w4 = w3.bgr;
    vec3 w5 = w2.bgr;
    vec3 w6 = w1.bgr;
    vec3 w7 = w0.bgr;
    vec3 half_sum = w0 + w1 + w2 + w3;
    vec3 w_sum = half_sum + half_sum.bgr;
    vec3 w_sum_inv = vec3(1.) / w_sum;
    mat2x2 true_pixel_to_tex_uv = mat2x2(pixel_to_tex_uv * fragment_aa_pixel_diameter);
    vec2 frame_sign = fragment_get_frame_sign(frame);
    vec2 uv_offset0 = xy_offset0 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset1 = xy_offset1 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset2 = xy_offset2 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec2 uv_offset3 = xy_offset3 * frame_sign * true_pixel_to_tex_uv;
    vec3 sample0 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset0).rgb;
    vec3 sample1 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample2 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample3 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv + uv_offset3).rgb;
    vec3 sample4 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset3).rgb;
    vec3 sample5 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset2).rgb;
    vec3 sample6 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset1).rgb;
    vec3 sample7 = fragment_tex2Daa_tiled_linearize(tex, tex_uv - uv_offset0).rgb;
